CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_history_original_frame_current55_v2_read(p_environment text, p_account_id text, p_currency text, p_through bigint, p_head text, p_after bigint, p_previous text, p_control_revision bigint, p_account_revision bigint, p_ledger_revision bigint, p_expires timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  head_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  current_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  witness_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  terminal public.demo_account_capture_events%ROWTYPE;
  d jsonb; r jsonb; a jsonb; w jsonb; wd jsonb; ref jsonb; measure record;
  sd jsonb; descriptor jsonb; reference_key text;
  descriptor_sequence bigint; descriptor_source_sequence bigint;
  descriptor_capture text; descriptor_event text;
  source_catalog jsonb; original_source_catalog jsonb;
  sources jsonb[] := ARRAY[]::jsonb[];
  chains jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  wire_rows jsonb; output jsonb;
  member_text text; checkpoint_text text; member_hash text; checkpoint_hash text;
  prior_sequence bigint := 0; witness_sequence bigint;
  source_bytes numeric := 0; event_count numeric := 0;
  metadata_bytes numeric; wire_bound numeric;
  expected_scope text; db_observed_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  IF p_environment IS DISTINCT FROM 'demo' OR p_account_id IS NULL
    OR p_account_id !~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$' OR p_currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'USDT'
    OR p_through IS NULL OR p_through<1 OR p_head IS NULL
    OR p_head !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR p_after IS NULL
    OR p_after<0 OR p_after>=p_through OR p_control_revision IS NULL
    OR p_control_revision<1 OR p_account_revision IS NULL OR p_account_revision<0
    OR p_ledger_revision IS NULL OR p_ledger_revision<0 OR p_expires IS NULL
    OR NOT isfinite(p_expires) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_arguments';
  END IF;
  IF (p_after=0 AND p_previous IS NOT NULL)
    OR (p_after>0 AND (p_previous IS NULL OR p_previous !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_cursor';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.account_history_partition_current55_v2_lock(
    p_environment,p_account_id,p_currency,p_control_revision,p_account_revision,
    p_ledger_revision,p_expires);
  -- Preserve UID -> Control -> scope -> head ordering. The stronger source
  -- locks exclude ordinary DML and source table DDL through BOTH phases.
  -- They do NOT claim to prevent CREATE OR REPLACE of a trigger function.
  LOCK TABLE public.demo_account_capture_events, public.demo_account_observation_batches, public.demo_account_observation_facts, public.demo_account_observation_coverage, public.demo_account_observation_findings IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
  
  source_catalog:=((
WITH relations AS (
 SELECT c.*,n.nspname FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname=ANY(ARRAY['demo_account_capture_events','demo_account_observation_batches','demo_account_observation_facts','demo_account_observation_coverage','demo_account_observation_findings'])
), functions AS (
 SELECT p.*,p.xmin::text AS catalog_xmin,n.nspname,l.lanname FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname=ANY(ARRAY['qualification_ledger_immutable','account_capture_event_guard','account_observation_batch_guard','account_observation_member_guard','account_observation_membership_guard'])
), constraints AS (
 SELECT x.*,c.relname FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint x JOIN relations c ON c.oid=x.conrelid
), indexes AS (
 SELECT i.*,c.relname,ic.relname AS index_name,am.amname FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i JOIN relations c ON c.oid=i.indrelid
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ic ON ic.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid=ic.relam
), triggers AS (
 SELECT t.*,c.relname,p.proname,fn.nspname AS function_namespace FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN relations c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal
), ri_triggers AS (
 SELECT t.*,x.relname AS constraint_table,x.conname,x.conrelid,x.confrelid,p.proname,n.nspname AS function_namespace
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN constraints x ON x.oid=t.tgconstraint AND x.contype='f'
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE t.tgisinternal
)

null,"table":"demo_account_observation_coverage","type":34,"when":null},{"arguments":"","constraint":false,"deferrable":false,"deferred":false,"enabled":"O","function":"account_observation_member_guard","function_namespace":"public","name":"observation_member_guard","new_table":null,"old_table":null,"table":"demo_account_observation_facts","type":7,"when":null},{"arguments":"","constraint":false,"deferrable":false,"deferred":false,"enabled":"O","function":"qualification_ledger_immutable","function_namespace":"public","name":"observation_member_immutable","new_table":null,"old_table":null,"table":"demo_account_observation_facts","type":27,"when":null},{"arguments":"","constraint":false,"deferrable":false,"deferred":false,"enabled":"O","function":"qualification_ledger_immutable","function_namespace":"public","name":"observation_member_no_truncate","new_table":null,"old_table":null,"table":"demo_account_observation_facts","type":34,"when":null},{"arguments":"","constraint":false,"deferrable":false,"deferred":false,"enabled":"O","function":"account_observation_member_guard","function_namespace":"public","name":"observation_member_guard","new_table":null,"old_table":null,"table":"demo_account_observation_findings","type":7,"when":null},{"arguments":"","constraint":false,"deferrable":false,"deferred":false,"enabled":"O","function":"qualification_ledger_immutable","function_namespace":"public","name":"observation_member_immutable","new_table":null,"old_table":null,"table":"demo_account_observation_findings","type":27,"when":null},{"arguments":"","constraint":false,"deferrable":false,"deferred":false,"enabled":"O","function":"qualification_ledger_immutable","function_namespace":"public","name":"observation_member_no_truncate","new_table":null,"old_table":null,"table":"demo_account_observation_findings","type":34,"when":null}]}'::jsonb     RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_source_schema_drift';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'identities'->'tables') x
    WHERE (x->>'owner_oid')::oid<>(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user)
      OR (x->>'namespace_oid')::oid<>'public'::regnamespace)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'identities'->'functions') x
    WHERE (x->>'owner_oid')::oid<>(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user)
      OR (x->>'namespace_oid')::oid<>'public'::regnamespace)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'identities'->'triggers') x
      JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'structure'->'triggers') y ON x->>'table'=y->>'table' AND x->>'name'=y->>'name'
      WHERE (x->>'function_oid')::oid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regprocedure('public.'||(y->>'function')||'()')
       OR (x->>'table_oid')::oid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass('public.'||(x->>'table')))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'identities'->'constraints') x
      JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'structure'->'constraints') y ON x->>'table'=y->>'table' AND x->>'name'=y->>'name'
      WHERE (x->>'table_oid')::oid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass('public.'||(x->>'table'))
       OR (x->>'target_oid')::oid IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN y->>'target' IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_regclass('public.'||(y->>'target')) END

    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'identities'->'ri_triggers') x
      WHERE x->'function_oid' IS DISTINCT FROM x->'function_expected_oid'
       OR x->'relation_oid' IS DISTINCT FROM x->'expected_relation_oid'
       OR x->'other_oid' IS DISTINCT FROM x->'expected_other_oid') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_source_identity_drift';
  END IF;

  IF source_catalog IS DISTINCT FROM original_source_catalog THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_source_catalog_changed';
  END IF;
  IF p_expires<=clock_timestamp() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_expired'; END IF;
  RETURN output;
END

functions.identity_arguments: p_environment text, p_account_id text, p_currency text, p_through bigint, p_head text, p_after bigint, p_previous text, p_control_revision bigint, p_account_revision bigint, p_ledger_revision bigint, p_expires timestamp with time zone
functions.name: account_history_original_frame_current55_v2_read
functions.source:
DECLARE
  head_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  current_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  witness_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  terminal public.demo_account_capture_events%ROWTYPE;
  d jsonb; r jsonb; a jsonb; w jsonb; wd jsonb; ref jsonb; measure record;
  sd jsonb; descriptor jsonb; reference_key text;
  descriptor_sequence bigint; descriptor_source_sequence bigint;
  descriptor_capture text; descriptor_event text;
  source_catalog jsonb; original_source_catalog jsonb;
  sources jsonb[] := ARRAY[]::jsonb[];
  chains jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  wire_rows jsonb; output jsonb;
  member_text text; checkpoint_text text; member_hash text; checkpoint_hash text;
  prior_sequence bigint := 0; witness_sequence bigint;
  source_bytes numeric := 0; event_count numeric := 0;
  metadata_bytes numeric; wire_bound numeric;
  expected_scope text; db_observed_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  IF p_environment IS DISTINCT FROM 'demo' OR p_account_id IS NULL
    OR p_account_id !~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$' OR p_currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'USDT'
    OR p_through IS NULL OR p_through<1 OR p_head IS NULL
    OR p_head !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR p_after IS NULL
    OR p_after<0 OR p_after>=p_through OR p_control_revision IS NULL
    OR p_control_revision<1 OR p_account_revision IS NULL OR p_account_revision<0
    OR p_ledger_revision IS NULL OR p_ledger_revision<0 OR p_expires IS NULL
    OR NOT isfinite(p_expires) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_arguments';
  END IF;
  IF (p_after=0 AND p_previous IS NOT NULL)
    OR (p_after>0 AND (p_previous IS NULL OR p_previous !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_cursor';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.account_history_partition_current55_v2_lock(
    p_environment,p_account_id,p_currency,p_control_revision,p_account_revision,
    p_ledger_revision,p_expires);
  -- Preserve UID -> Control -> scope -> head ordering. The stronger source
  -- locks exclude ordinary DML and source table DDL through BOTH phases.
  -- They do NOT claim to prevent CREATE OR REPLACE of a trigger function.
  LOCK TABLE public.demo_account_capture_events, public.demo_account_observation_batches, public.demo_account_observation_facts, public.demo_account_observation_coverage, public.demo_account_observation_findings IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
  
  source_catalog:=((
WITH relations AS (
 SELECT c.*,n.nspname FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname=ANY(ARRAY['demo_account_capture_events','demo_account_observation_batches','demo_account_observation_facts','demo_account_observation_coverage','demo_account_observation_findings'])
), functions AS (
 SELECT p.*,p.xmin::text AS catalog_xmin,n.nspname,l.lanname FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname=ANY(ARRAY['qualification_ledger_immutable','account_capture_event_guard','account_observation_batch_guard','account_observation_member_guard','account_observation_membership_guard'])
), constraints AS (
 SELECT x.*,c.relname FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint x JOIN relations c ON c.oid=x.conrelid
), indexes AS (
 SELECT i.*,c.relname,ic.relname AS index_name,am.amname FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i JOIN relations c ON c.oid=i.indrelid
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ic ON ic.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid=ic.relam
), triggers AS (
 SELECT t.*,c.relname,p.proname,fn.nspname AS function_namespace FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN relations c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal
), ri_triggers AS (
 SELECT t.*,x.relname AS constraint_table,x.conname,x.conrelid,x.confrelid,p.proname,n.nspname AS function_namespace
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN constraints x ON x.oid=t.tgconstraint AND x.contype='f'
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE t.tgisinternal
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version','ctcc.account_original_source_actual_catalog.v1',
 'structure',jsonb_build_object(
  'tables',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'namespace',c.nspname,'kind',c.relkind,'persistence',c.relpersistence,
   'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'partition',c.relispartition,'has_rules',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_rewrite z WHERE z.ev_class=c.oid),'inherited',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits h WHERE h.inhrelid=c.oid OR h.inhparent=c.oid),
   'has_policies',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy y WHERE y.polrelid=c.oid)) ORDER BY c.relname COLLATE "C") FROM relations c),'[]'::jsonb),
  'columns',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'position',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),
   'nullable',NOT a.attnotnull,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'generated',a.attgenerated,'identity',a.attidentity) ORDER BY c.relname COLLATE "C",a.attnum)
   FROM relations c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
   WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),'[]'::jsonb),
  'constraints',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',x.relname,'name',x.conname,'kind',x.contype,
   'columns',CASE WHEN x.contype IN ('c','t') THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY z.ord) FROM unnest(x.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY z(attnum,ord) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=x.conrelid AND a.attnum=z.attnum) END,
   'target',CASE WHEN x.confrelid=0 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT relname FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE oid=x.confrelid) END,
   'target_namespace',(SELECT n.nspname FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.oid=x.confrelid),
   'target_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY z.ord) FROM unnest(x.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY z(attnum,ord) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=x.confrelid AND a.attnum=z.attnum),
   'validated',x.convalidated,'deferrable',x.condeferrable,'deferred',x.condeferred,'delete_action',x.confdeltype,'update_action',x.confupdtype,'match',x.confmatchtype)
   ORDER BY x.relname COLLATE "C",x.conname COLLATE "C") FROM constraints x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'indexes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',i.relname,'name',i.index_name,
   'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY z.ord) FROM unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY z(attnum,ord) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=i.indrelid AND a.attnum=z.attnum),
   'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'live',i.indislive,'method',i.amname,
   'predicate',pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),'expressions',pg_get_expr(i.indexprs,i.indrelid),'include_count',i.indnatts-i.indnkeyatts,
   'nulls_not_distinct',i.indnullsnotdistinct,'exclusion',i.indisexclusion,'immediate',i.indimmediate) ORDER BY i.relname COLLATE "C",i.index_name COLLATE "C") FROM indexes i),'[]'::jsonb),
  'functions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'namespace',p.nspname,'arguments',oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes),'returns',pg_get_function_result(p.oid),
   'language',p.lanname,'source_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex'),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,
   'config',p.proconfig,'kind',p.prokind,'parallel',p.proparallel,'strict',p.proisstrict,'leakproof',p.proleakproof) ORDER BY p.proname COLLATE "C",p.oid) FROM functions p),'[]'::jsonb),
  'triggers',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.relname,'name',t.tgname,'function',t.proname,'function_namespace',t.function_namespace,
   'enabled',t.tgenabled,'type',t.tgtype,'deferrable',t.tgdeferrable,'deferred',t.tginitdeferred,'constraint',t.tgconstraint<>0,'arguments',encode(t.tgargs,'hex'),
   'when',pg_get_expr(t.tgqual,t.tgrelid),'old_table',t.tgoldtable,'new_table',t.tgnewtable) ORDER BY t.relname COLLATE "C",t.tgname COLLATE "C") FROM triggers t),'[]'::jsonb),
  'ri_triggers',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.constraint_table,'constraint',t.conname,
   'relation',CASE WHEN t.tgrelid=t.conrelid THEN 'child' WHEN t.tgrelid=t.confrelid THEN 'parent' ELSE 'foreign' END,
   'function',t.proname,'function_namespace',t.function_namespace,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'type',t.tgtype,'deferrable',t.tgdeferrable,
   'deferred',t.tginitdeferred,'arguments',encode(t.tgargs,'hex'),'when',pg_get_expr(t.tgqual,t.tgrelid))
   ORDER BY t.constraint_table COLLATE "C",t.conname COLLATE "C",t.proname COLLATE "C") FROM ri_triggers t),'[]'::jsonb)),
 'identities',jsonb_build_object(
  'tables',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'oid',c.oid::bigint,'namespace_oid',c.relnamespace::bigint,'owner_oid',c.relowner::bigint) ORDER BY c.relname COLLATE "C") FROM relations c),'[]'::jsonb),
  'functions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'oid',p.oid::bigint,'namespace_oid',p.pronamespace::bigint,'owner_oid',p.proowner::bigint,'catalog_xmin',p.catalog_xmin) ORDER BY p.proname COLLATE "C",p.oid) FROM functions p),'[]'::jsonb),
  'constraints',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',x.relname,'name',x.conname,'table_oid',x.conrelid::bigint,'target_oid',nullif(x.confrelid,0)::bigint,
   'index_oid',nullif(x.conindid,0)::bigint,'index_expected_oid',CASE WHEN x.contype IN ('p','u') THEN to_regclass('public.'||x.conname)::oid::bigint
    WHEN x.contype='f' THEN (SELECT conindid::bigint FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint pk WHERE pk.conrelid=x.confrelid AND pk.contype='p') ELSE NULL END)
   ORDER BY x.relname COLLATE "C",x.conname COLLATE "C") FROM constraints x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'triggers',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.relname,'name',t.tgname,'table_oid',t.tgrelid::bigint,'function_oid',t.tgfoid::bigint) ORDER BY t.relname COLLATE "C",t.tgname COLLATE "C") FROM triggers t),'[]'::jsonb),
  'ri_triggers',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.constraint_table,'constraint',t.conname,'function',t.proname,
   'function_oid',t.tgfoid::bigint,'function_expected_oid',to_regprocedure('pg_catalog.'||quote_ident(t.proname)||'()')::oid::bigint,
   'relation_oid',t.tgrelid::bigint,'other_oid',t.tgconstrrelid::bigint,
   'expected_relation_oid',(CASE WHEN t.proname IN ('RI_FKey_check_ins','RI_FKey_check_upd') THEN t.conrelid ELSE t.confrelid END)::bigint,
   'expected_other_oid',(CASE WHEN t.proname IN ('RI_FKey_check_ins','RI_FKey_check_upd') THEN t.confrelid ELSE t.conrelid END)::bigint)
   ORDER BY t.constraint_table COLLATE "C",t.conname COLLATE "C",t.proname COLLATE "C") FROM ri_triggers t),'[]'::jsonb)),
 'definitions',jsonb_build_object(
  'constraints',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',x.relname,'name',x.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(x.oid,true),'expression',pg_get_expr(x.conbin,x.conrelid)) ORDER BY x.relname COLLATE "C",x.conname COLLATE "C") FROM constraints x),'[]'::jsonb),
  'indexes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',i.relname,'name',i.index_name,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)) ORDER BY i.relname COLLATE "C",i.index_name COLLATE "C") FROM indexes i),'[]'::jsonb),
  'functions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) ORDER BY p.proname COLLATE "C",p.oid) FROM functions p),'[]'::jsonb),
  'triggers',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.relname,'name',t.tgname,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true)) ORDER BY t.relname COLLATE "C",t.tgname COLLATE "C") FROM triggers t),'[]'::jsonb)))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_history_original_frame_v1_read(p_environment text, p_account_id text, p_currency text, p_through bigint, p_head text, p_after bigint, p_previous text, p_control_revision bigint, p_account_revision bigint, p_ledger_revision bigint, p_expires timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  head_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  current_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  witness_row public.demo_account_observation_batches%ROWTYPE;
  terminal public.demo_account_capture_events%ROWTYPE;
  d jsonb; r jsonb; a jsonb; w jsonb; wd jsonb; ref jsonb; measure record;
  sd jsonb; descriptor jsonb; reference_key text;
  descriptor_sequence bigint; descriptor_source_sequence bigint;
  descriptor_capture text; descriptor_event text;
  source_catalog jsonb; original_source_catalog jsonb;
  sources jsonb[] := ARRAY[]::jsonb[];
  chains jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  wire_rows jsonb; output jsonb;
  member_text text; checkpoint_text text; member_hash text; checkpoint_hash text;
  prior_sequence bigint := 0; witness_sequence bigint;
  source_bytes numeric := 0; event_count numeric := 0;
  metadata_bytes numeric; wire_bound numeric;
  expected_scope text; db_observed_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  IF p_environment IS DISTINCT FROM 'demo' OR p_account_id IS NULL
    OR p_account_id !~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$' OR p_currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'USDT'
    OR p_through IS NULL OR p_through<1 OR p_head IS NULL
    OR p_head !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR p_after IS NULL
    OR p_after<0 OR p_after>=p_through OR p_control_revision IS NULL
    OR p_control_revision<1 OR p_account_revision IS NULL OR p_account_revision<0
    OR p_ledger_revision IS NULL OR p_ledger_revision<0 OR p_expires IS NULL
    OR NOT isfinite(p_expires) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_arguments';
  END IF;
  IF (p_after=0 AND p_previous IS NOT NULL)
    OR (p_after>0 AND (p_previous IS NULL OR p_previous !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_cursor';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.account_history_partition_v1_lock(
    p_environment,p_account_id,p_currency,p_control_revision,p_account_revision,
    p_ledger_revision,p_expires);
  -- Preserve UID -> Control -> scope -> head ordering. The stronger source
  -- locks exclude ordinary DML and source table DDL through BOTH phases.
  -- They do NOT claim to prevent CREATE OR REPLACE of a trigger function.
  LOCK TABLE public.demo_account_capture_events, public.demo_account_observation_batches, public.demo_account_observation_facts, public.demo_account_observation_coverage, public.demo_account_observation_findings IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
  
  source_catalog:=((
WITH relations AS (
 SELECT c.*,n.nspname FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname=ANY(ARRAY['demo_account_capture_events','demo_account_observation_batches','demo_account_observation_facts','demo_account_observation_coverage','demo_account_observation_findings'])

      JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'structure'->'triggers') y ON x->>'table'=y->>'table' AND x->>'name'=y->>'name'

       OR (x->>'table_oid')::oid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass('public.'||(x->>'table')))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'identities'->'constraints') x
      JOIN jsonb_array_elements(source_catalog->'structure'->'constraints') y ON x->>'table'=y->>'table' AND x->>'name'=y->>'name'
      WHERE (x->>'table_oid')::oid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass('public.'||(x->>'table'))

    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_source_catalog_changed';
  END IF;

  RETURN output;

DECLARE

  descriptor_sequence bigint; descriptor_source_sequence bigint;
  descriptor_capture text; descriptor_event text;
  source_catalog jsonb; original_source_catalog jsonb;

  chains jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  wire_rows jsonb; output jsonb;
  member_text text; checkpoint_text text; member_hash text; checkpoint_hash text;
  prior_sequence bigint := 0; witness_sequence bigint;
  source_bytes numeric := 0; event_count numeric := 0;
  metadata_bytes numeric; wire_bound numeric;
  expected_scope text; db_observed_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  IF p_environment IS DISTINCT FROM 'demo' OR p_account_id IS NULL
    OR p_account_id !~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$' OR p_currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'USDT'
    OR p_through IS NULL OR p_through<1 OR p_head IS NULL
    OR p_head !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR p_after IS NULL
    OR p_after<0 OR p_after>=p_through OR p_control_revision IS NULL
    OR p_control_revision<1 OR p_account_revision IS NULL OR p_account_revision<0
    OR p_ledger_revision IS NULL OR p_ledger_revision<0 OR p_expires IS NULL
    OR NOT isfinite(p_expires) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_arguments';
  END IF;
  IF (p_after=0 AND p_previous IS NOT NULL)
    OR (p_after>0 AND (p_previous IS NULL OR p_previous !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_cursor';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.account_history_partition_v1_lock(
    p_environment,p_account_id,p_currency,p_control_revision,p_account_revision,
    p_ledger_revision,p_expires);
  -- Preserve UID -> Control -> scope -> head ordering. The stronger source
  -- locks exclude ordinary DML and source table DDL through BOTH phases.
  -- They do NOT claim to prevent CREATE OR REPLACE of a trigger function.
  LOCK TABLE public.demo_account_capture_events, public.demo_account_observation_batches, public.demo_account_observation_facts, public.demo_account_observation_coverage, public.demo_account_observation_findings IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;

WITH relations AS (

), functions AS (

), constraints AS (
 SELECT x.*,c.relname FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint x JOIN relations c ON c.oid=x.conrelid
), indexes AS (
 SELECT i.*,c.relname,ic.relname AS index_name,am.amname FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i JOIN relations c ON c.oid=i.indrelid

), triggers AS (
 SELECT t.*,c.relname,p.proname,fn.nspname AS function_namespace FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN relations c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid

), ri_triggers AS (
 SELECT t.*,x.relname AS constraint_table,x.conname,x.conrelid,x.confrelid,p.proname,n.nspname AS function_namespace
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN constraints x ON x.oid=t.tgconstraint AND x.contype='f'
 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE t.tgisinternal

    RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_source_catalog_changed';
  END IF;
  IF p_expires<=clock_timestamp() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original_frame_expired'; END IF;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_history_partition_current55_v2_lock(p_environment text, p_account_id text, p_currency text, p_control_revision bigint, p_account_revision bigint, p_ledger_revision bigint, p_expires timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE c public.demo_account_controls%ROWTYPE; q public.qualification_account_scopes%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF p_environment IS DISTINCT FROM 'demo' OR p_account_id !~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$'
   OR p_currency IS DISTINCT FROM 'USDT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_history_partition_scope'; END IF;
 IF current_user=session_user OR current_setting('role')<>'none'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=session_user
     AND (r.rolsuper OR r.rolcreatedb OR r.rolcreaterole OR r.rolreplication OR r.rolbypassrls))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname<>session_user AND pg_has_role(session_user,r.oid,'MEMBER'))
   OR has_schema_privilege(session_user,'public','CREATE')
   OR has_database_privilege(session_user,current_database(),'CREATE') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_history_partition_role_denied'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed'
   OR current_setting('TimeZone')<>'UTC' OR current_setting('synchronous_commit')<>'on'
   OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin' OR pg_is_in_recovery()
   OR current_setting('fsync')<>'on' OR current_setting('full_page_writes')<>'on' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_history_partition_session_denied'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(('x'||substr(encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||pg_catalog.convert_to(p_environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||pg_catalog.convert_to(p_account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint);
 SELECT * INTO c FROM public.demo_account_controls WHERE environment=p_environment AND account_id=p_account_id FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO q FROM public.qualification_account_scopes WHERE environment=p_environment AND account_id=p_account_id AND settlement_currency=p_currency FOR UPDATE;
 IF c.account_id IS NULL OR q.account_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_history_partition_parent_missing'; END IF;
 IF p_control_revision IS NULL OR p_account_revision IS NULL OR p_ledger_revision IS NULL
   OR p_control_revision<1 OR p_account_revision<0 OR p_ledger_revision<0
   OR c.control_revision<>p_control_revision OR q.account_revision<>p_account_revision OR q.ledger_revision<>p_ledger_revision
   OR c.emergency_stop IS DISTINCT FROM false OR c.arm_request_id IS NULL
   OR c.arm_expires_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(c.arm_expires_at)
   OR c.owner_sha256 IS NULL OR c.owner_epoch IS NULL OR c.owner_epoch<1
   OR c.lease_until IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(c.lease_until)
   OR p_expires IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_expires)
   OR p_expires<=clock_timestamp() OR p_expires>c.lease_until
   OR p_expires>c.arm_expires_at OR c.arm_expires_at<=clock_timestamp() THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'current55_controlled_history_armed_fence_changed'; END IF;
 IF (p_control_revision IS NULL)<>(p_account_revision IS NULL) OR (p_control_revision IS NULL)<>(p_ledger_revision IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_history_partition_fence_invalid'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.demo_account_observation_batches WHERE environment=p_environment AND account_id=p_account_id AND settlement_currency=p_currency ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE;
 LOCK TABLE public.qualification_account_scopes, public.demo_account_controls, public.demo_account_observation_batches, public.demo_account_capture_events,
   public.demo_account_history_native_members, public.demo_account_history_partition_checkpoints IN ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;
END

DECLARE a RECORD; c RECORD; cj RECORD; l RECORD; b RECORD; r RECORD;
        p jsonb; claims jsonb; hw jsonb; sampled timestamptz;
        lineage_expires timestamptz; hwm_expires timestamptz;
        lock_key bigint; n bigint;
BEGIN
  IF current_setting('role')<>'none' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_role_denied';
  END IF;
  SELECT oid,rolsuper,rolcreaterole,rolbypassrls INTO r
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user;
  IF r.oid IS NULL OR r.rolsuper OR r.rolcreaterole OR r.rolbypassrls THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_role_denied';
  END IF;
  lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')
    ||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')
    ||convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.demo_account_controls
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO a FROM public.qualification_account_scopes
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO cj FROM public.demo_control_journal
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND control_revision=NEW.control_revision FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO l FROM public.demo_collector_current_revision_lineages
    WHERE lineage_sha256=NEW.source_lineage_sha256 FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO b FROM public.public_runtime_raw_bundles_v1
    WHERE bundle_id=NEW.hwm_custody_id FOR KEY SHARE;
  p := NEW.proof_json::jsonb;
  claims := NEW.claims_json::jsonb;
  hw := convert_from(b.bundle_raw,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  sampled := (p->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz;
  lineage_expires := (l.lineage_json::jsonb->>'original_expires_at')::timestamptz;
  hwm_expires := (hw->'observed_source'->>'original_request_expires_at')::timestamptz;
  IF a.account_revision IS NULL OR c.control_revision IS NULL
    OR cj.control_revision IS NULL OR l.lineage_sha256 IS NULL OR b.bundle_id IS NULL
    OR ROW(a.account_revision,a.ledger_revision,a.claims_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.previous_account_revision,NEW.previous_ledger_revision,NEW.previous_claims_sha256)
    OR ROW(l.environment,l.account_id,l.settlement_currency,l.account_revision,l.ledger_revision,l.claims_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency,
         NEW.previous_account_revision,NEW.previous_ledger_revision,NEW.previous_claims_sha256)
    OR ROW(l.control_revision,l.control_event_sha256,l.control_state_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.control_revision,NEW.control_event_sha256,NEW.control_state_sha256)
    OR ROW(c.control_revision,c.state_sha256,cj.state_sha256,cj.event_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.control_revision,NEW.control_state_sha256,
         NEW.control_state_sha256,NEW.control_event_sha256)
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(c.state_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM c.state_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(cj.event_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM cj.event_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(l.lineage_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM l.lineage_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(b.bundle_raw),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_sha256
    OR b.bundle_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.hwm_bundle_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.proof_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.issuer_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.claims_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
    OR p->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.collector_issued_account_revision.v1'
    OR p->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
    OR p->>'claims_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
    OR p->>'source_lineage_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_lineage_sha256
    OR p->>'hwm_custody_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_id
    OR p->>'hwm_bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_sha256
    OR p->'previous_account_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.previous_account_revision)
    OR p->'previous_ledger_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.previous_ledger_revision)
    OR p->'account_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.account_revision)
    OR p->'ledger_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.ledger_revision)
    OR p->'control_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.control_revision)
    OR p->>'control_event_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_event_sha256
    OR p->>'control_state_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_state_sha256
    OR p->'db_role_oid' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(r.oid::bigint)
    OR p->'db_backend_pid' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(pg_backend_pid())
    OR p->>'db_transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id()::text
    OR (p->>'original_expires_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.original_expires_at
    OR lineage_expires IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(lineage_expires)
    OR hwm_expires IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(hwm_expires)
    OR NOT isfinite(NEW.original_expires_at)
    OR NEW.original_expires_at > lineage_expires
    OR NEW.original_expires_at > hwm_expires
    OR sampled IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(sampled) OR sampled>=NEW.original_expires_at
    OR clock_timestamp()>=NEW.original_expires_at
    OR b.recorded_at>sampled OR l.db_recorded_at>sampled
    OR (hw->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_owned_sampled_balance_peak_record.v1'
      AND hw->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_owned_controlled_balance_peak_record.v2')
    OR hw->'observed_source'->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM p->'scope'
    OR hw->'observed_source'->'current_source_reference'
       IS DISTINCT FROM l.lineage_json::jsonb->'source_reference'
    OR hw->'observed_source'->>'current_proof_envelope_sha256'
       IS DISTINCT FROM l.lineage_json::jsonb->>'proof_envelope_sha256'
    OR hw->'historical_account_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    OR hw->'account_revision_issued' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR hw->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR claims->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.account_ledger_claims.v2'
    OR claims->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM p->'scope'
    OR p->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_binding_denied';
  END IF;
  -- Historical v1 checks above remain exact. Only the explicit controlled v2
  -- schema enters this additional finite measured-policy/source binding path.
  IF hw->>'schema_version'='ctcc.native_owned_controlled_balance_peak_record.v2' THEN
    IF jsonb_typeof(hw) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(hw))<>11
      OR hw->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'f82775c69bef1e9c70ec4607b1497ea7b3264817970879c825ff76d18b78b047'
      OR hw->'initial_account_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR hw->'external_cashflow_adjustment' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR hw->'cashflow_adjusted_drawdown' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR hw->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
      OR octet_length(b.bundle_raw) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'owner_sampled_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR NOT isfinite((hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz)
      OR NOT isfinite(b.recorded_at)
      OR (hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz>b.recorded_at
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(hw->'observed_source'))<>17
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'current_balance_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM 'latest_measured_original_index_member'
      OR claims->'claims'->>'payload_schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.account_ledger_claims.finite_api_asof.v1'
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'financial_schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.account_financial_operands.finite_api_asof.v1'
      OR claims->'claims'->'account'->'original_start_seed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'original_start_seed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'actual_continuous_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'cashflow_adjusted_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR hw->'observed_source'->'current_source_reference'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->'current_source_reference'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'original_prefix_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'original_prefix_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'original_raw_bank_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'original_raw_bank_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'api_population_receipt_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'api_population_receipt_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_policy_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_hwm_policy_sha256'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'measured_hwm_receipt_json') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR octet_length(hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152
      OR encode(sha256(convert_to(hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json','UTF8')),'hex')
        IS DISTINCT FROM hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_sha256'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'financial_source_receipt_json') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR octet_length(hw->'observed_source'->>'financial_source_receipt_json') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152
      OR encode(sha256(convert_to(hw->'observed_source'->>'financial_source_receipt_json','UTF8')),'hex')
        IS DISTINCT FROM hw->'observed_source'->>'financial_source_receipt_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'financial_source_receipt_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'source_receipt_sha256'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'measured_peak_equity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'measured_current_equity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->'measured_peak_equity'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->'measured_peak_equity'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->'measured_current_equity'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->'measured_current_equity'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'measured_peak_observed_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR NOT isfinite((hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz)
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz
        IS DISTINCT FROM (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'drawdown_window_started_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR NOT isfinite((hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz)
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz
        IS DISTINCT FROM (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_hwm_window_started_at')::timestamptz
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz
        IS DISTINCT FROM (claims->'claims'->'risk_policy'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz
        >(hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz
        >(hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz
      OR (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'evaluated_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR NOT isfinite((claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'evaluated_at')::timestamptz)
      OR (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'evaluated_at')::timestamptz>(hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz
      OR (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'original_expires_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM hwm_expires
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'drawdown_basis'
        IS DISTINCT FROM 'every_accepted_measured_balance_in_original_window' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_controlled_hwm_binding_denied';
    END IF;
    -- A new prospective counter is a durable one-time policy basis, not an
    -- assertion that pre-origin/global history or original seed was zero.
    IF claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'loss_streak_basis'='explicit_operator_policy_counter' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.demo_policy_counter_initializations_v1 init
        WHERE init.initialization_sha256=claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'init_ack_sha256'
          AND ROW(init.environment,init.account_id,init.settlement_currency)
            =ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          AND init.initialized_at=(claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'init_at')::timestamptz
          AND init.initialized_at=init.db_recorded_at
          AND init.initialized_at<=(claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'source_as_of_at')::timestamptz
          AND init.configured_policy_sha256=
            (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json')::jsonb->>'configured_policy_sha256'
          AND init.measured_genesis_sha256=
            (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json')::jsonb->>'measured_genesis_sha256'
          AND init.measured_genesis_json=
            (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json')::jsonb->>'measured_genesis_json'
          AND encode(sha256(convert_to(init.configured_policy_json,'UTF8')),'hex')=init.configured_policy_sha256
          AND encode(sha256(convert_to(init.measured_genesis_json,'UTF8')),'hex')=init.measured_genesis_sha256
          AND (init.measured_genesis_json::jsonb->>'body_completed_at')::timestamptz
            =(claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_hwm_window_started_at')::timestamptz
          AND init.configured_policy_json::jsonb->>'portfolio_risk_policy_sha256'
            =claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'original_risk_policy_sha256') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_policy_counter_binding_denied';
      END IF;
    ELSIF claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'loss_streak_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM 'observed_positive_reset'
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'init_ack_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'init_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_streak_basis_unknown';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  -- The native issuer verifies the exact proof bytes and all coverage operands;
  -- these SQL shape checks confer no authenticity on a manually supplied row.
  IF jsonb_typeof(p->'proofs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p->'proofs'))<>12
    OR NOT (p->'proofs' ?& ARRAY['registration','current_identity','history_prefix',
      'product_scope','history_coverage','cashflow_and_funding_finality','loss_streak_seed',
      'unchanged_window_drawdown','inventory_metadata','protection','local_ledger','current_portfolio'])
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(p->'proofs') e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string'
      OR e.value#>>'{}' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_proof_membership_denied';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.qualification_account_scopes
    SET account_revision=NEW.account_revision,ledger_revision=NEW.ledger_revision,
        claims_json=NEW.claims_json,claims_sha256=NEW.claims_sha256,
        updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency
      AND account_revision=NEW.previous_account_revision
      AND ledger_revision=NEW.previous_ledger_revision
      AND claims_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.previous_claims_sha256;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;
  IF n<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_revision_conflict';
  END IF;
  NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
  IF NEW.db_recorded_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(NEW.db_recorded_at) OR NEW.db_recorded_at<sampled OR NEW.db_recorded_at>=NEW.original_expires_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_final_expiry';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_write_denied';
END;
functions.name: collector_issued_account_revision_guard_v1

constraints: CHECK (control_revision > 0 AND octet_length(claims_json) >= 1 AND octet_length(claims_json) <= 8388608 AND octet_length(proof_json) >= 1 AND octet_length(proof_json) <= 1048576)

CHECK (issuer_sha256::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND claims_sha256::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND source_lineage_sha256::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND hwm_bundle_sha256::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND hwm_custody_id::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$'::text AND control_event_sha256::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND control_state_sha256::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND (previous_claims_sha256 IS NULL OR previous_claims_sha256::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text))

CHECK (previous_account_revision >= 0 AND previous_ledger_revision >= previous_account_revision AND account_revision = (previous_account_revision + 1) AND ledger_revision = (previous_ledger_revision + 1))
FOREIGN KEY (environment, account_id, control_revision) REFERENCES demo_control_journal(environment, account_id, control_revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (hwm_custody_id) REFERENCES public_runtime_raw_bundles_v1(bundle_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (environment, account_id, settlement_currency) REFERENCES qualification_account_scopes(environment, account_id, settlement_currency) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (source_lineage_sha256) REFERENCES demo_collector_current_revision_lineages(lineage_sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT
custody_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER public_runtime_bundle_v1_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public_runtime_raw_bundles_v1 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public_runtime_bundle_v1_immutable()
CREATE TRIGGER public_runtime_bundle_v1_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON public_runtime_raw_bundles_v1 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public_runtime_bundle_v1_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER public_runtime_bundle_v1_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public_runtime_raw_bundles_v1 FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION public_runtime_bundle_v1_immutable()
functions:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.collector_issued_account_revision_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE a RECORD; c RECORD; cj RECORD; l RECORD; b RECORD; r RECORD;
        p jsonb; claims jsonb; hw jsonb; sampled timestamptz;
        lineage_expires timestamptz; hwm_expires timestamptz;
        lock_key bigint; n bigint;
BEGIN
  IF current_setting('role')<>'none' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_role_denied';
  END IF;
  SELECT oid,rolsuper,rolcreaterole,rolbypassrls INTO r
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user;
  IF r.oid IS NULL OR r.rolsuper OR r.rolcreaterole OR r.rolbypassrls THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_role_denied';
  END IF;
  lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')
    ||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')
    ||convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.demo_account_controls
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO a FROM public.qualification_account_scopes
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO cj FROM public.demo_control_journal
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND control_revision=NEW.control_revision FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO l FROM public.demo_collector_current_revision_lineages
    WHERE lineage_sha256=NEW.source_lineage_sha256 FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO b FROM public.public_runtime_raw_bundles_v1
    WHERE bundle_id=NEW.hwm_custody_id FOR KEY SHARE;
  p := NEW.proof_json::jsonb;
  claims := NEW.claims_json::jsonb;
  hw := convert_from(b.bundle_raw,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  sampled := (p->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz;
  lineage_expires := (l.lineage_json::jsonb->>'original_expires_at')::timestamptz;
  hwm_expires := (hw->'observed_source'->>'original_request_expires_at')::timestamptz;
  IF a.account_revision IS NULL OR c.control_revision IS NULL
    OR cj.control_revision IS NULL OR l.lineage_sha256 IS NULL OR b.bundle_id IS NULL
    OR ROW(a.account_revision,a.ledger_revision,a.claims_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.previous_account_revision,NEW.previous_ledger_revision,NEW.previous_claims_sha256)
    OR ROW(l.environment,l.account_id,l.settlement_currency,l.account_revision,l.ledger_revision,l.claims_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency,
         NEW.previous_account_revision,NEW.previous_ledger_revision,NEW.previous_claims_sha256)
    OR ROW(l.control_revision,l.control_event_sha256,l.control_state_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.control_revision,NEW.control_event_sha256,NEW.control_state_sha256)
    OR ROW(c.control_revision,c.state_sha256,cj.state_sha256,cj.event_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.control_revision,NEW.control_state_sha256,
         NEW.control_state_sha256,NEW.control_event_sha256)
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(c.state_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM c.state_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(cj.event_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM cj.event_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(l.lineage_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM l.lineage_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(b.bundle_raw),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_sha256
    OR b.bundle_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.hwm_bundle_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.proof_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.issuer_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.claims_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
    OR p->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.collector_issued_account_revision.v1'
    OR p->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
    OR p->>'claims_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
    OR p->>'source_lineage_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_lineage_sha256
    OR p->>'hwm_custody_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_id
    OR p->>'hwm_bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_sha256
    OR p->'previous_account_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.previous_account_revision)
    OR p->'previous_ledger_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.previous_ledger_revision)
    OR p->'account_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.account_revision)
    OR p->'ledger_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.ledger_revision)
    OR p->'control_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.control_revision)
    OR p->>'control_event_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_event_sha256
    OR p->>'control_state_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_state_sha256
    OR p->'db_role_oid' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(r.oid::bigint)
    OR p->'db_backend_pid' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(pg_backend_pid())
    OR p->>'db_transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id()::text
    OR (p->>'original_expires_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.original_expires_at
    OR lineage_expires IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(lineage_expires)
    OR hwm_expires IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(hwm_expires)
    OR NOT isfinite(NEW.original_expires_at)
    OR NEW.original_expires_at > lineage_expires
    OR NEW.original_expires_at > hwm_expires
    OR sampled IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(sampled) OR sampled>=NEW.original_expires_at
    OR clock_timestamp()>=NEW.original_expires_at
    OR b.recorded_at>sampled OR l.db_recorded_at>sampled
    OR (hw->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_owned_sampled_balance_peak_record.v1'
      AND hw->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_owned_controlled_balance_peak_record.v2')
    OR hw->'observed_source'->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM p->'scope'
    OR hw->'observed_source'->'current_source_reference'
       IS DISTINCT FROM l.lineage_json::jsonb->'source_reference'
    OR hw->'observed_source'->>'current_proof_envelope_sha256'
       IS DISTINCT FROM l.lineage_json::jsonb->>'proof_envelope_sha256'
    OR hw->'historical_account_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
    OR hw->'account_revision_issued' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR hw->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR claims->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.account_ledger_claims.v2'
    OR claims->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM p->'scope'
    OR p->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_binding_denied';
  END IF;
  -- Historical v1 checks above remain exact. Only the explicit controlled v2
  -- schema enters this additional finite measured-policy/source binding path.
  IF hw->>'schema_version'='ctcc.native_owned_controlled_balance_peak_record.v2' THEN
    IF jsonb_typeof(hw) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(hw))<>11
      OR hw->>'policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'f82775c69bef1e9c70ec4607b1497ea7b3264817970879c825ff76d18b78b047'
      OR hw->'initial_account_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR hw->'external_cashflow_adjustment' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR hw->'cashflow_adjusted_drawdown' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR hw->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
      OR octet_length(b.bundle_raw) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'owner_sampled_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR NOT isfinite((hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz)
      OR NOT isfinite(b.recorded_at)
      OR (hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz>b.recorded_at
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(hw->'observed_source'))<>17
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'current_balance_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM 'latest_measured_original_index_member'
      OR claims->'claims'->>'payload_schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.account_ledger_claims.finite_api_asof.v1'
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'financial_schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.account_financial_operands.finite_api_asof.v1'
      OR claims->'claims'->'account'->'original_start_seed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'original_start_seed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'actual_continuous_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'cashflow_adjusted_peak' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR hw->'observed_source'->'current_source_reference'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->'current_source_reference'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'original_prefix_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'original_prefix_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'original_raw_bank_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'original_raw_bank_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'api_population_receipt_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'api_population_receipt_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_policy_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_hwm_policy_sha256'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'measured_hwm_receipt_json') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR octet_length(hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152
      OR encode(sha256(convert_to(hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json','UTF8')),'hex')
        IS DISTINCT FROM hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_sha256'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'financial_source_receipt_json') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR octet_length(hw->'observed_source'->>'financial_source_receipt_json') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152
      OR encode(sha256(convert_to(hw->'observed_source'->>'financial_source_receipt_json','UTF8')),'hex')
        IS DISTINCT FROM hw->'observed_source'->>'financial_source_receipt_sha256'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->>'financial_source_receipt_sha256'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'source_receipt_sha256'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'measured_peak_equity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'measured_current_equity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->'measured_peak_equity'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->'measured_peak_equity'
      OR hw->'observed_source'->'measured_current_equity'
        IS DISTINCT FROM claims->'claims'->'financial'->'measured_current_equity'
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'measured_peak_observed_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR NOT isfinite((hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz)
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz
        IS DISTINCT FROM (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz
      OR jsonb_typeof(hw->'observed_source'->'drawdown_window_started_at') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR NOT isfinite((hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz)
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz
        IS DISTINCT FROM (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_hwm_window_started_at')::timestamptz
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz
        IS DISTINCT FROM (claims->'claims'->'risk_policy'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'drawdown_window_started_at')::timestamptz
        >(hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz
      OR (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_peak_observed_at')::timestamptz
        >(hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz
      OR (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'evaluated_at')::timestamptz IS NULL
      OR NOT isfinite((claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'evaluated_at')::timestamptz)
      OR (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'evaluated_at')::timestamptz>(hw->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz
      OR (claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'original_expires_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM hwm_expires
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'drawdown_basis'
        IS DISTINCT FROM 'every_accepted_measured_balance_in_original_window' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_controlled_hwm_binding_denied';
    END IF;
    -- A new prospective counter is a durable one-time policy basis, not an
    -- assertion that pre-origin/global history or original seed was zero.
    IF claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'loss_streak_basis'='explicit_operator_policy_counter' THEN
      IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.demo_policy_counter_initializations_v1 init
        WHERE init.initialization_sha256=claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'init_ack_sha256'
          AND ROW(init.environment,init.account_id,init.settlement_currency)
            =ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
          AND init.initialized_at=(claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'init_at')::timestamptz
          AND init.initialized_at=init.db_recorded_at
          AND init.initialized_at<=(claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'source_as_of_at')::timestamptz
          AND init.configured_policy_sha256=
            (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json')::jsonb->>'configured_policy_sha256'
          AND init.measured_genesis_sha256=
            (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json')::jsonb->>'measured_genesis_sha256'
          AND init.measured_genesis_json=
            (hw->'observed_source'->>'measured_hwm_receipt_json')::jsonb->>'measured_genesis_json'
          AND encode(sha256(convert_to(init.configured_policy_json,'UTF8')),'hex')=init.configured_policy_sha256
          AND encode(sha256(convert_to(init.measured_genesis_json,'UTF8')),'hex')=init.measured_genesis_sha256
          AND (init.measured_genesis_json::jsonb->>'body_completed_at')::timestamptz
            =(claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'measured_hwm_window_started_at')::timestamptz
          AND init.configured_policy_json::jsonb->>'portfolio_risk_policy_sha256'
            =claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'original_risk_policy_sha256') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_policy_counter_binding_denied';
      END IF;
    ELSIF claims->'claims'->'financial'->>'loss_streak_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM 'observed_positive_reset'
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'init_ack_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
      OR claims->'claims'->'financial'->'init_at' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_streak_basis_unknown';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  -- The native issuer verifies the exact proof bytes and all coverage operands;
  -- these SQL shape checks confer no authenticity on a manually supplied row.
  IF jsonb_typeof(p->'proofs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p->'proofs'))<>12
    OR NOT (p->'proofs' ?& ARRAY['registration','current_identity','history_prefix',
      'product_scope','history_coverage','cashflow_and_funding_finality','loss_streak_seed',
      'unchanged_window_drawdown','inventory_metadata','protection','local_ledger','current_portfolio'])
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(p->'proofs') e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string'
      OR e.value#>>'{}' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_proof_membership_denied';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.qualification_account_scopes
    SET account_revision=NEW.account_revision,ledger_revision=NEW.ledger_revision,
        claims_json=NEW.claims_json,claims_sha256=NEW.claims_sha256,
        updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency
      AND account_revision=NEW.previous_account_revision
      AND ledger_revision=NEW.previous_ledger_revision
      AND claims_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.previous_claims_sha256;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;
  IF n<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_revision_conflict';
  END IF;
  NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
  IF NEW.db_recorded_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(NEW.db_recorded_at) OR NEW.db_recorded_at<sampled OR NEW.db_recorded_at>=NEW.original_expires_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_final_expiry';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_write_denied';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.collector_issued_account_revision_immutable_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_issuer_immutable';
END;
$function$
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX demo_collector_issued_account_revisions_pkey ON public.demo_collector_issued_account_revisions USING btree (issuer_sha256)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_collector_issued_once_per_current ON public.demo_collector_issued_account_revisions USING btree (source_lineage_sha256)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_collector_issued_scope_revision ON public.demo_collector_issued_account_revisions USING btree (environment, account_id, settlement_currency, account_revision)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER collector_issued_revision_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON demo_collector_issued_account_revisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION collector_issued_account_revision_immutable_v1()
CREATE TRIGGER collector_issued_revision_insert BEFORE INSERT ON demo_collector_issued_account_revisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION collector_issued_account_revision_guard_v1()
CREATE TRIGGER collector_issued_revision_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON demo_collector_issued_account_revisions FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION collector_issued_account_revision_immutable_v1()

functions.body:
DECLARE a RECORD; c RECORD; cj RECORD; b RECORD; f RECORD; t RECORD; e RECORD;
        role_row RECORD; j jsonb; bd jsonb; part jsonb; lock_key bigint;
        captured_count bigint; n bigint := 0; sampled timestamptz; expires timestamptz;
BEGIN
  -- SECURITY DEFINER is limited to cross-checking existing private rows. It
  -- does not expose those rows and cannot be called as a data-returning API.
  IF current_setting('role')<>'none' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_role_denied';
  END IF;
  SELECT oid,rolsuper,rolcreaterole,rolbypassrls INTO role_row
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user;
  IF role_row.oid IS NULL OR role_row.rolsuper OR role_row.rolcreaterole OR role_row.rolbypassrls THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_role_denied';
  END IF;
  lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')
    ||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')
    ||convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.demo_account_controls
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO a FROM public.qualification_account_scopes
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO cj FROM public.demo_control_journal
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND control_revision=NEW.control_revision FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO b FROM public.public_runtime_raw_bundles_v1
    WHERE bundle_id=NEW.custody_id FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO f FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
    WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id AND sequence=1 FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO t FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
    WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id AND sequence=NEW.current_terminal_sequence FOR KEY SHARE;
  j := NEW.lineage_json::jsonb;
  bd := convert_from(b.bundle_raw,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  sampled := (j->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz;
  expires := (j->>'original_expires_at')::timestamptz;
  IF NEW.environment<>'demo' OR NEW.account_id !~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$'
    OR NEW.settlement_currency !~ '^[A-Z0-9]{1,16}$'
    OR NEW.account_revision<0 OR NEW.ledger_revision<NEW.account_revision
    OR NEW.control_revision<=0 OR NEW.current_terminal_sequence<=0
    OR octet_length(NEW.lineage_json) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144
    OR a.account_revision IS NULL OR c.control_revision IS NULL OR cj.control_revision IS NULL
    OR b.bundle_id IS NULL OR f.sequence IS NULL OR t.sequence IS NULL
    OR ROW(a.account_revision,a.ledger_revision,a.claims_json,a.claims_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.account_revision,NEW.ledger_revision,NEW.claims_json,NEW.claims_sha256)
    OR c.control_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_revision
    OR c.state_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_state_sha256
    OR cj.state_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM c.state_sha256
    OR cj.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_event_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(c.state_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM c.state_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(cj.event_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM cj.event_sha256
    OR ROW(f.environment,f.account_id,f.settlement_currency)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
    OR ROW(t.environment,t.account_id,t.settlement_currency)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
    OR t.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_head_sha256
    OR t.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
    OR t.event_json::jsonb->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded'
    OR f.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'contract_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_current_account_plan.v7'
    OR b.contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 1
    OR encode(sha256(b.bundle_raw),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.lineage_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.lineage_sha256
    OR jsonb_typeof(j) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR j->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.collector_owned_current_revision_lineage.v1'
    OR j->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
    OR j->'account_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.account_revision)
    OR j->'ledger_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.ledger_revision)
    OR j->>'claims_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
    OR j->>'claims_binding_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'UNAUTHENTICATED_LEDGER_SNAPSHOT'
    OR j->'control_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.control_revision)
    OR j->>'control_event_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_event_sha256
    OR j->>'control_state_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_state_sha256
    OR j->>'custody_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_id
    OR j->>'source_bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_sha256
    OR j->>'proof_envelope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.proof_envelope_sha256
    OR j->>'source_policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bd->>'policy_sha256'
    OR j->'source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM bd->'proof_envelope'->'source_reference'
    OR j->'source_reference'->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_capture_id
    OR j->'source_reference'->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_head_sha256
    OR j->'source_reference'->>'plan_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM f.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'plan_sha256'
    OR j->'source_reference'->>'session_binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM f.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'session_binding_sha256'
    OR j->>'native_proof_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bd->'proof_envelope'->>'native_proof_sha256'
    OR j->>'native_readback_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bd->'proof_envelope'->>'native_readback_sha256'
    OR j->'db_role_oid' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(role_row.oid::bigint)
    OR j->'db_backend_pid' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(pg_backend_pid())
    OR j->>'db_transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id()::text
    OR j->'account_revision_issued' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR j->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR j->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR j->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
    OR j->'unresolved_obligations' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(
      'complete_source_derived_portfolio_snapshot_unavailable',
      'full_history_funding_and_finality_unproven',
      'source_derived_loss_streak_seed_unknown',
      'preserved_native_hwm_and_drawdown_window_unproven',
      'registered_account_region_unverified','complete_account_revision_not_issued')
    OR sampled IS NULL OR expires IS NULL OR sampled>=expires OR clock_timestamp()>=expires
    OR (j->>'packet_completed_at')::timestamptz > (j->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz
    OR (j->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz > sampled
    OR t.db_recorded_at > (j->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz
    OR b.recorded_at > (j->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz
    OR (NEW.account_revision=0 AND (NEW.claims_json IS NOT NULL OR NEW.claims_sha256 IS NOT NULL))
    OR (NEW.account_revision>0 AND (NEW.claims_json IS NULL OR NEW.claims_sha256 IS NULL
        OR octet_length(NEW.claims_json) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608
        OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.claims_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256))
    OR jsonb_typeof(bd->'chain') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(bd->'chain') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_terminal_sequence THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_binding_denied';
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO captured_count FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
    WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id;
  IF captured_count<>NEW.current_terminal_sequence THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_binding_denied';
  END IF;
  FOR part IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(bd->'chain') LOOP
    n := n+1;
    SELECT * INTO e FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
      WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id AND sequence=n FOR KEY SHARE;
    IF e.sequence IS NULL
      OR part->>'event_hex' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(convert_to(e.event_json,'UTF8'),'hex')
      OR part->>'raw_hex' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(e.raw_body,'hex')
      OR part->>'packet_hex' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(e.packet_payload,'hex')
      OR (part->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM e.db_recorded_at THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_original_bytes_changed';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  -- UID serialization also enforces the composite identity if its index has
  -- drifted; runtime catalogue admission independently requires that index.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.demo_collector_current_revision_lineages x
      WHERE ROW(x.environment,x.account_id,x.settlement_currency,x.account_revision,
                x.control_revision,x.current_capture_id)
        =ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency,NEW.account_revision,
             NEW.control_revision,NEW.current_capture_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_duplicate';
  END IF;
  NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_write_denied';
END;
functions.name: collector_current_revision_lineage_guard_v1

constraints: CHECK (octet_length(lineage_json) >= 1 AND octet_length(lineage_json) <= 262144 AND (claims_json IS NULL OR octet_length(claims_json) >= 1 AND octet_length(claims_json) <= 8388608))
CHECK (account_revision = 0 AND claims_json IS NULL AND claims_sha256 IS NULL OR account_revision > 0 AND claims_json IS NOT NULL AND claims_sha256::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text)
