CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.collector_current_revision_lineage_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE a RECORD; c RECORD; cj RECORD; b RECORD; f RECORD; t RECORD; e RECORD;
        role_row RECORD; j jsonb; bd jsonb; part jsonb; lock_key bigint;
        captured_count bigint; n bigint := 0; sampled timestamptz; expires timestamptz;
BEGIN
  -- SECURITY DEFINER is limited to cross-checking existing private rows. It
  -- does not expose those rows and cannot be called as a data-returning API.
  IF current_setting('role')<>'none' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_role_denied';
  END IF;
  SELECT oid,rolsuper,rolcreaterole,rolbypassrls INTO role_row
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user;
  IF role_row.oid IS NULL OR role_row.rolsuper OR role_row.rolcreaterole OR role_row.rolbypassrls THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_role_denied';
  END IF;
  lock_key := ('x'||substr(encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8')
    ||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.environment,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')
    ||convert_to(NEW.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,16))::bit(64)::bigint;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(lock_key);
  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.demo_account_controls
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO a FROM public.qualification_account_scopes
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND settlement_currency=NEW.settlement_currency FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT * INTO cj FROM public.demo_control_journal
    WHERE environment=NEW.environment AND account_id=NEW.account_id
      AND control_revision=NEW.control_revision FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO b FROM public.public_runtime_raw_bundles_v1
    WHERE bundle_id=NEW.custody_id FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO f FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
    WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id AND sequence=1 FOR KEY SHARE;
  SELECT * INTO t FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
    WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id AND sequence=NEW.current_terminal_sequence FOR KEY SHARE;
  j := NEW.lineage_json::jsonb;
  bd := convert_from(b.bundle_raw,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  sampled := (j->>'owner_sampled_at')::timestamptz;
  expires := (j->>'original_expires_at')::timestamptz;
  IF NEW.environment<>'demo' OR NEW.account_id !~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$'
    OR NEW.settlement_currency !~ '^[A-Z0-9]{1,16}$'
    OR NEW.account_revision<0 OR NEW.ledger_revision<NEW.account_revision
    OR NEW.control_revision<=0 OR NEW.current_terminal_sequence<=0
    OR octet_length(NEW.lineage_json) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144
    OR a.account_revision IS NULL OR c.control_revision IS NULL OR cj.control_revision IS NULL
    OR b.bundle_id IS NULL OR f.sequence IS NULL OR t.sequence IS NULL
    OR ROW(a.account_revision,a.ledger_revision,a.claims_json,a.claims_sha256)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.account_revision,NEW.ledger_revision,NEW.claims_json,NEW.claims_sha256)
    OR c.control_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_revision
    OR c.state_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_state_sha256
    OR cj.state_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM c.state_sha256
    OR cj.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_event_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(c.state_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM c.state_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(cj.event_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM cj.event_sha256
    OR ROW(f.environment,f.account_id,f.settlement_currency)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
    OR ROW(t.environment,t.account_id,t.settlement_currency)
       IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
    OR t.event_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_head_sha256
    OR t.event_json::jsonb->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
    OR t.event_json::jsonb->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded'
    OR f.event_json::jsonb->'data'->'plan'->>'contract_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_current_account_plan.v7'
    OR b.contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 1
    OR encode(sha256(b.bundle_raw),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_sha256
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.lineage_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.lineage_sha256
    OR jsonb_typeof(j) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR j->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.collector_owned_current_revision_lineage.v1'
    OR j->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency)
    OR j->'account_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.account_revision)
    OR j->'ledger_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.ledger_revision)
    OR j->>'claims_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256
    OR j->>'claims_binding_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'UNAUTHENTICATED_LEDGER_SNAPSHOT'
    OR j->'control_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW.control_revision)
    OR j->>'control_event_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_event_sha256
    OR j->>'control_state_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.control_state_sha256
    OR j->>'custody_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_id
    OR j->>'source_bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.bundle_sha256
    OR j->>'proof_envelope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.proof_envelope_sha256
    OR j->>'source_policy_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bd->>'policy_sha256'
    OR j->'source_reference' IS DISTINCT FROM bd->'proof_envelope'->'source_reference'
    OR j->'source_reference'->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_capture_id
    OR j->'source_reference'->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_head_sha256
    OR j->'source_reference'->>'plan_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM f.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'plan_sha256'
    OR j->'source_reference'->>'session_binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM f.event_json::jsonb->'data'->>'session_binding_sha256'
    OR j->>'native_proof_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bd->'proof_envelope'->>'native_proof_sha256'
    OR j->>'native_readback_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bd->'proof_envelope'->>'native_readback_sha256'
    OR j->'db_role_oid' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(role_row.oid::bigint)
    OR j->'db_backend_pid' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(pg_backend_pid())
    OR j->>'db_transaction_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id()::text
    OR j->'account_revision_issued' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR j->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR j->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR j->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
    OR j->'unresolved_obligations' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(
      'complete_source_derived_portfolio_snapshot_unavailable',
      'full_history_funding_and_finality_unproven',
      'source_derived_loss_streak_seed_unknown',
      'preserved_native_hwm_and_drawdown_window_unproven',
      'registered_account_region_unverified','complete_account_revision_not_issued')
    OR sampled IS NULL OR expires IS NULL OR sampled>=expires OR clock_timestamp()>=expires
    OR (j->>'packet_completed_at')::timestamptz > (j->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz
    OR (j->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz > sampled
    OR t.db_recorded_at > (j->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz
    OR b.recorded_at > (j->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz
    OR (NEW.account_revision=0 AND (NEW.claims_json IS NOT NULL OR NEW.claims_sha256 IS NOT NULL))
    OR (NEW.account_revision>0 AND (NEW.claims_json IS NULL OR NEW.claims_sha256 IS NULL
        OR octet_length(NEW.claims_json) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608
        OR encode(sha256(convert_to(NEW.claims_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claims_sha256))
    OR jsonb_typeof(bd->'chain') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(bd->'chain') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.current_terminal_sequence THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_binding_denied';
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO captured_count FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
    WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id;
  IF captured_count<>NEW.current_terminal_sequence THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_binding_denied';
  END IF;
  FOR part IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(bd->'chain') LOOP
    n := n+1;
    SELECT * INTO e FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
      WHERE capture_id=NEW.current_capture_id AND sequence=n FOR KEY SHARE;
    IF e.sequence IS NULL
      OR part->>'event_hex' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(convert_to(e.event_json,'UTF8'),'hex')
      OR part->>'raw_hex' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(e.raw_body,'hex')
      OR part->>'packet_hex' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(e.packet_payload,'hex')
      OR (part->>'db_recorded_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM e.db_recorded_at THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_original_bytes_changed';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  -- UID serialization also enforces the composite identity if its index has
  -- drifted; runtime catalogue admission independently requires that index.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.demo_collector_current_revision_lineages x
      WHERE ROW(x.environment,x.account_id,x.settlement_currency,x.account_revision,
                x.control_revision,x.current_capture_id)
        =ROW(NEW.environment,NEW.account_id,NEW.settlement_currency,NEW.account_revision,
             NEW.control_revision,NEW.current_capture_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_duplicate';
  END IF;
  NEW.db_recorded_at := clock_timestamp();
  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector_lineage_write_denied';
END;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.qualification_reservation_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  native_ok boolean := false;
  s record; c record; o record; prior record; t record; b record; m record; p record; q record; issued record;
  lineage record; capture_row record;
  witness jsonb; manifest jsonb; assessment jsonb; request jsonb; inner_intent jsonb; expected jsonb;
  page jsonb; meta jsonb; part jsonb; payload jsonb; query jsonb;
  issued_snapshot jsonb; source_reference jsonb; event_document jsonb; original_plan jsonb;
  issued_snapshot_json text;
  scalar jsonb; source_row jsonb; source_clock text; clock_name text; numeric_field text;
  documents jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; queries jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  eof_milliseconds jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  role_name text; part_id text; body bytea; old_head text := NULL;
  sequence_no bigint := 0; offset_no bigint; page_no integer := 0;
  outcome_revision bigint := 0; previous_recorded_at timestamptz;
  first_at timestamptz; last_at timestamptz; previous_eof timestamptz;
  first_mono numeric; previous_mono numeric; read_session text; credential_session text;
  lock_hex text; names text[] := ARRAY[
    'config_before','order_before','fills_recent','fills_history','balance','positions','account_risk',
    'pending_orders','algo_conditional','algo_oco','algo_chase','algo_trigger','algo_move_order_stop',
    'algo_iceberg','algo_twap','algo_smart_iceberg','leverage','order_after','config_after'];
  finite_decimal text := '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,23})(\.[0-9]{1,24})?$';
  capture_sequence bigint := 0; capture_bytes bigint := 0; capture_head text := NULL;
  packet_count integer := 0; packet_sha256 text;
BEGIN
  -- This branch computes a DATA predicate from retained rows/raw documents.
  -- The application additionally requires its genuine new read-source owner,
  -- immutable target and independent committed full readback. No JSON flag is
  -- an owner, order permit, renewed Arm or source-authentication assertion.
  IF OLD.state='uncertain' AND NEW.state='reconciled_flat'
     AND OLD.state_revision=3 AND NEW.state_revision=4
     AND OLD.environment='demo'
     AND OLD.request_json::jsonb->>'contract_version'='ctcc-reservation-request-native-v4' THEN
    BEGIN
      request := OLD.request_json::jsonb;
      lock_hex := encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8') || decode('00','hex') ||
        convert_to(OLD.environment,'UTF8') || decode('00','hex') || convert_to(OLD.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex');
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks l WHERE l.locktype='advisory'
        AND l.pid=pg_backend_pid() AND l.granted AND l.mode='ExclusiveLock' AND l.objsubid=1
        AND l.database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
        AND l.classid::bigint=(('x'||substr(lock_hex,1,8))::bit(32)::bigint)
        AND l.objid::bigint=(('x'||substr(lock_hex,9,8))::bit(32)::bigint)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_actual_uid_lock_required';
      END IF;
      -- Reconciliation never renews Arm/lease. It nevertheless serializes the
      -- actual current Control before scope, including expired/stopped states.
      SELECT * INTO c FROM public.demo_account_controls
        WHERE environment=OLD.environment AND account_id=OLD.account_id FOR UPDATE;
      IF c.account_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_control_required'; END IF;
      SELECT * INTO s FROM public.qualification_account_scopes
        WHERE environment=OLD.environment AND account_id=OLD.account_id
          AND settlement_currency=OLD.settlement_currency FOR UPDATE;
      SELECT * INTO b FROM public.qualification_reservation_transitions
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id AND state_revision=1;
      SELECT * INTO t FROM public.qualification_reservation_transitions
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id AND state_revision=2;
      SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.qualification_reservation_transitions
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id AND state_revision=3;
      SELECT * INTO o FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
      IF s.account_id IS NULL OR t.id IS NULL OR b.id IS NULL OR prior.id IS NULL OR o.outcome_id IS NULL
         OR s.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.updated_at OR o.recorded_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.updated_at
         OR s.ledger_revision IS DISTINCT FROM o.ledger_revision
         OR prior.from_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'consumed' OR prior.to_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'uncertain'
         OR prior.reason_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'post_submit_native_uncertain_v1'
         OR prior.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.updated_at
         OR b.from_state IS NOT NULL OR b.to_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'reserved'
         OR b.reason_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'risk_reserved_control_bound_v1'
         OR t.from_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'reserved' OR t.to_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'consumed'
         OR t.reason_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'consumed_with_control_bound_intent_v1'
         OR t.evidence_json::jsonb->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc-control-bound-submit-intent-v1'
         OR t.evidence_json::jsonb->>'reservation_binding_json' IS DISTINCT FROM b.evidence_json
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(t.evidence_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM o.intent_sha256
         OR o.intent_transition_id IS DISTINCT FROM t.id OR o.observation_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'reconciliation'
         OR o.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'rejected' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_lineage_required';
      END IF;
      inner_intent := (t.evidence_json::jsonb->>'intent_json')::jsonb;
      expected := inner_intent->'exact_order';
      witness := o.capture_json::jsonb;
      IF inner_intent->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc-demo-submit-intent-native-v2'
         OR inner_intent->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_sha256
         OR witness->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_zero_fok_flat_closure.v1'
         OR witness->>'reservation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_id
         OR witness->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_sha256
         OR witness->>'intent_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM o.intent_sha256
         OR witness->>'original_credential_session_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
         OR witness->>'issued_row_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'issued_row_sha256'
         OR (witness->>'exact_order_json')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM expected
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(witness->>'exact_order_json','UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM o.exchange_request_sha256
         OR witness->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR witness->'order_retry_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR expected->>'ordType' IS DISTINCT FROM 'fok' OR expected->>'tdMode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'isolated'
         OR expected->'reduceOnly' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR NOT COALESCE(expected->>'side' IN ('buy','sell'),false)
         OR expected->>'posSide' IS DISTINCT FROM inner_intent->'execution_binding'->>'position_side'
         OR expected->>'clOrdId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc'||left(OLD.reservation_id,28)
         OR inner_intent->>'protection_client_order_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CTA'||left(OLD.reservation_id,29) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_native_witness_required';
      END IF;
      SELECT * INTO issued FROM public.demo_collector_issued_account_revisions
        WHERE issuer_sha256=request->>'issuer_sha256';
      -- Recompute the existing canonical flat20 snapshot from the ACTUAL row.
      -- JSON-valued claims/proof remain original canonical ASCII strings,
      -- never decoded and reserialized. All actual source-supported scalar
      -- strings must be printable ASCII: canonical ensure_ascii=True already
      -- escapes Unicode/control members INSIDE the retained claims/proof.
      -- This avoids pretending generic Unicode jsonb::text equals that codec.
      -- Timestamp strings match the issuer's UTC isoformat
      -- (six microsecond digits when nonzero, no fractional suffix when zero).
      issued_snapshot := to_jsonb(issued) || jsonb_build_object(
        'original_expires_at',to_char(issued.original_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')||
          CASE WHEN extract(microseconds FROM issued.original_expires_at)::bigint % 1000000=0 THEN ''
          ELSE '.'||to_char(issued.original_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','US') END||'+00:00',
        'db_recorded_at',to_char(issued.db_recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')||
          CASE WHEN extract(microseconds FROM issued.db_recorded_at)::bigint % 1000000=0 THEN ''
          ELSE '.'||to_char(issued.db_recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','US') END||'+00:00');
      FOR scalar IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_each(issued_snapshot) LOOP
        IF jsonb_typeof(scalar)='string' AND NOT coalesce((scalar#>>'{}') COLLATE "C" ~ '^[ -~]*$',false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_issued_canonical_ascii_required';
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
      SELECT '{'||string_agg(to_jsonb(key)::text||':'||value::text,',' ORDER BY key COLLATE "C")||'}'
        INTO issued_snapshot_json FROM jsonb_each(issued_snapshot);
      IF issued.issuer_sha256 IS NULL OR issued.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment
         OR issued.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
         OR issued.settlement_currency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency
         OR issued.account_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (request->>'expected_account_revision')::bigint
         OR issued.ledger_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (request->>'expected_ledger_revision')::bigint
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(issued.proof_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM issued.issuer_sha256
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(issued.claims_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM issued.claims_sha256
         OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(issued_snapshot))<>20
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(issued_snapshot_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'issued_row_sha256' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_issued_row_required';
      END IF;
      SELECT * INTO lineage FROM public.demo_collector_current_revision_lineages
        WHERE lineage_sha256=issued.source_lineage_sha256;
      IF lineage.lineage_sha256 IS NULL
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(lineage.lineage_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM lineage.lineage_sha256
         OR lineage.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment OR lineage.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
         OR lineage.settlement_currency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_lineage_required';
      END IF;
      source_reference := lineage.lineage_json::jsonb->'source_reference';
      -- Replay the entire ORIGINAL immutable B1 chain under this same writer
      -- transaction, rather than accepting a fresh config's self-asserted UID.
      FOR capture_row IN SELECT * FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
        WHERE capture_id=lineage.current_capture_id ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 8193 LOOP
        capture_sequence := capture_sequence+1;
        capture_bytes := capture_bytes+octet_length(capture_row.event_json)
          +coalesce(octet_length(capture_row.raw_body),0)+coalesce(octet_length(capture_row.packet_payload),0);
        event_document := capture_row.event_json::jsonb;
        IF capture_sequence>8192 OR capture_bytes>67108864 OR capture_row.sequence<>capture_sequence
           OR capture_row.chain_bytes<>capture_bytes OR capture_row.previous_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM capture_head
           OR capture_row.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment OR capture_row.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
           OR capture_row.settlement_currency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency
           OR encode(sha256(convert_to(capture_row.event_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM capture_row.event_sha256
           OR event_document->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_account_ingestion_event.v1'
           OR event_document->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM capture_row.capture_id
           OR (event_document->>'sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM capture_sequence
           OR event_document->>'previous_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM capture_head
           OR event_document->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
           OR event_document->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
           OR event_document->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
           OR event_document->>'raw_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN capture_row.raw_body IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE encode(sha256(capture_row.raw_body),'hex') END)
           OR event_document->>'packet_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN capture_row.packet_payload IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE encode(sha256(capture_row.packet_payload),'hex') END) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_capture_chain_required';
        END IF;
        IF capture_sequence=1 THEN
          original_plan := event_document->'data'->'plan';
          IF event_document->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'capture_start'
             OR event_document->'data'->>'plan_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM source_reference->>'plan_sha256'
             OR event_document->'data'->>'session_binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
             OR encode(sha256(convert_to(original_plan->>'session_binding_id','UTF8')),'hex')
                  IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
             OR original_plan->>'expected_uid' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
             OR original_plan->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment
             OR original_plan->>'settlement_currency' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency
             OR original_plan->>'expected_main_uid' IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'original_main_uid'
             OR NOT coalesce((original_plan->>'expected_main_uid') ~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$',false)
             OR original_plan->>'origin' IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'original_origin'
             OR original_plan->>'origin' IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_account_identity_required';
          END IF;
        END IF;
        IF capture_row.packet_payload IS NOT NULL THEN
          packet_count := packet_count+1;
          packet_sha256 := encode(sha256(capture_row.packet_payload),'hex');
        END IF;
        capture_head := capture_row.event_sha256;
      END LOOP;
      IF capture_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM lineage.current_terminal_sequence OR capture_sequence<2
         OR capture_head IS DISTINCT FROM lineage.current_head_sha256 OR packet_count<>1
         OR source_reference->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM lineage.current_capture_id
         OR source_reference->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM capture_head
         OR source_reference->>'packet_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM packet_sha256
         OR source_reference->>'session_binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
         OR event_document->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
         OR event_document->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_complete_capture_required';
      END IF;
      -- All retained outcomes remain an immutable exact chain; a late witness
      -- cannot discard an earlier ACK/unknown, part or conflicting observation.
      FOR q IN SELECT * FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 4097 LOOP
        sequence_no := sequence_no+1;
        IF sequence_no>4096 OR q.sequence<>sequence_no OR q.previous_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM old_head
           OR q.intent_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM o.intent_sha256 OR q.intent_transition_id IS DISTINCT FROM t.id
           OR q.exchange_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM o.exchange_request_sha256
           OR encode(sha256(convert_to(q.capture_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM q.capture_sha256
           OR encode(sha256(convert_to(q.outcome_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM q.outcome_id
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_submission_outcome.v1'
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'capture_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM q.capture_sha256
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'reservation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_id
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM q.sequence
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'previous_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM q.previous_sha256
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'intent_transition_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM t.id
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'intent_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM q.intent_sha256
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'exchange_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM q.exchange_request_sha256
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_sha256
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM q.status
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'observation_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM q.observation_kind
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'ledger_revision')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM q.ledger_revision
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM q.recorded_at
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'observed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM q.observed_at
           OR q.ledger_revision<=outcome_revision OR q.observed_at>q.recorded_at
           OR (previous_recorded_at IS NOT NULL AND q.recorded_at<previous_recorded_at)
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->'order_retry_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
           OR (sequence_no=1 AND (q.observation_kind<>'initial' OR q.status<>'uncertain')) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_outcome_chain_required';
        END IF;
        old_head := q.outcome_id;
        outcome_revision := q.ledger_revision;
        previous_recorded_at := q.recorded_at;
      END LOOP;
      IF sequence_no<3 OR old_head IS DISTINCT FROM o.outcome_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_outcome_chain_required';
      END IF;
      SELECT * INTO m FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
        WHERE outcome_id=witness->>'manifest_outcome_id' AND reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id;
      manifest := m.capture_json::jsonb;
      assessment := (witness->>'assessment_json')::jsonb;
      IF m.outcome_id IS NULL OR m.sequence>=o.sequence OR m.observation_kind<>'reconciliation'
         OR m.status<>'uncertain' OR manifest->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_read_manifest.v1'
         OR manifest->>'computation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'
         OR manifest->>'reservation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_id
         OR manifest->>'assessment_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'assessment_sha256'
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(witness->>'assessment_json','UTF8')),'hex')
              IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'assessment_sha256'
         OR assessment->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_postsubmit_reconciliation_computation.v1'
         OR assessment->>'reservation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_id
         OR assessment->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_sha256
         OR assessment->>'intent_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM o.intent_sha256
         OR assessment->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR assessment->'order_retry_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR assessment->>'classification' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal_zero_fill_flat'
         OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'pages') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
         OR jsonb_array_length(manifest->'pages')<>19 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_manifest_required';
      END IF;
      FOR page IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'pages') LOOP
        page_no := page_no+1;
        role_name := page->>'role';
        IF role_name IS DISTINCT FROM names[page_no] OR page_no>19 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_required_chronology_missing';
        END IF;
        SELECT * INTO p FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
          WHERE outcome_id=page->>'metadata' AND reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id;
        meta := p.capture_json::jsonb;
        IF p.outcome_id IS NULL OR p.sequence>=m.sequence OR p.observation_kind<>'reconciliation' OR p.status<>'uncertain'
           OR meta->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_read_page_metadata.v1'
           OR meta->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->>'capture_id'
           OR (meta->>'page_index')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM page_no-1 OR meta->>'role' IS DISTINCT FROM role_name
           OR (meta->>'status')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM 200 OR jsonb_typeof(page->'parts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
           OR NOT jsonb_array_length(page->'parts') BETWEEN 1 AND 8 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_page_metadata_required';
        END IF;
        IF page_no=1 THEN
          first_at := (meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz;
          first_mono := (meta->>'started_monotonic_ns')::numeric;
          read_session := meta->>'read_session_id';
          credential_session := meta->>'credential_session_sha256';
        END IF;
        last_at := (meta->>'eof_at')::timestamptz;
        IF NOT COALESCE((read_session ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND credential_session ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
           AND credential_session IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
           AND meta->>'read_session_id'=read_session AND meta->>'credential_session_sha256'=credential_session
           AND meta->>'original_credential_session_sha256'=request->>'credential_session_sha256'
           AND first_at<=(meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz
           AND (meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz<=(meta->>'headers_at')::timestamptz
           AND (meta->>'headers_at')::timestamptz<=last_at AND last_at<=NEW.updated_at
           AND (meta->>'started_monotonic_ns')::numeric<=(meta->>'headers_monotonic_ns')::numeric
           AND (meta->>'headers_monotonic_ns')::numeric<=(meta->>'eof_monotonic_ns')::numeric
           AND (previous_eof IS NULL OR previous_eof<(meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz)
           AND (previous_mono IS NULL OR previous_mono<(meta->>'started_monotonic_ns')::numeric)
           AND (meta->>'eof_monotonic_ns')::numeric-first_mono<=60000000000),false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_new_read_session_or_chronology_required';
        END IF;
        previous_eof := last_at;
        previous_mono := (meta->>'eof_monotonic_ns')::numeric;
        body := ''::bytea; offset_no := 0;
        FOR part_id IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(page->'parts') LOOP
          SELECT * INTO q FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
            WHERE outcome_id=part_id AND reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id;
          part := q.capture_json::jsonb;
          IF q.outcome_id IS NULL OR q.sequence<=p.sequence OR q.sequence>=m.sequence
             OR q.observation_kind<>'reconciliation' OR q.status<>'uncertain'
             OR part->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_read_raw_part.v1'
             OR part->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->>'capture_id'
             OR (part->>'page_index')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM page_no-1
             OR part->>'metadata_outcome_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p.outcome_id
             OR (part->>'offset')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM offset_no
             OR NOT COALESCE((octet_length(part->>'raw_hex') BETWEEN 2 AND 131072
                 AND octet_length(part->>'raw_hex') % 2=0
                 AND (part->>'raw_hex') ~ '^[a-f0-9]+$'),false)
             OR encode(sha256(decode(part->>'raw_hex','hex')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM part->>'raw_sha256' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_raw_parts_required';
          END IF;
          body := body || decode(part->>'raw_hex','hex');
          offset_no := octet_length(body);
          IF offset_no>524288 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_raw_page_bound'; END IF;
        END LOOP;
        IF offset_no IS DISTINCT FROM (meta->>'body_bytes')::bigint
           OR encode(sha256(body),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM meta->>'body_sha256'
           OR meta->>'body_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM page->>'body_sha256' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_raw_page_digest_required';
        END IF;
        payload := convert_from(body,'UTF8')::jsonb;
        IF payload->>'code' IS DISTINCT FROM '0' OR jsonb_typeof(payload->'data') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
           OR jsonb_typeof(meta->'parameters') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_raw_document_required';
        END IF;
        -- Every present source clock is checked against THIS page's actual
        -- EOF. Update times may remain old; they are never restamped or forced
        -- to follow dispatch. Nested risk members have no invented clock.
        FOR q IN
          WITH RECURSIVE nodes(value,depth) AS (
            SELECT convert_from(body,'UTF8')::json,0
            UNION ALL
            SELECT child.value,n.depth+1 FROM nodes n CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
              SELECT value FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_typeof(n.value)='object' THEN n.value ELSE '{}'::json END)
              UNION ALL
              SELECT value FROM json_array_elements(CASE WHEN json_typeof(n.value)='array' THEN n.value ELSE '[]'::json END)
            ) child
          ) SELECT value,depth,json_typeof(value) AS kind FROM nodes
        LOOP
          -- Preserve JSON pairs until duplicate validation. Casting directly
          -- to jsonb would discard an earlier conflicting member. Match the
          -- existing strict native decoder's plain DATA limits as well.
          IF q.depth>24 OR (q.kind='number' AND NOT (q.value::text) ~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_plain_json_required';
          END IF;
          IF q.kind='array' THEN
            IF json_array_length(q.value)>4096 THEN
              RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_plain_json_required';
            END IF;
          END IF;
          IF q.kind<>'object' THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
          IF (SELECT count(*)>128 OR count(*)<>count(DISTINCT key COLLATE "C") FROM json_each(q.value)) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_duplicate_or_unbounded_json_object';
          END IF;
          scalar := q.value::jsonb;
          FOREACH clock_name IN ARRAY ARRAY['cTime','uTime','fillTime','ts'] LOOP
            IF scalar ? clock_name AND scalar->clock_name NOT IN ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb) THEN
              source_clock := scalar->>clock_name;
              IF jsonb_typeof(scalar->clock_name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
                 OR NOT coalesce(source_clock ~ '^[0-9]{1,16}$',false)
                 OR source_clock::numeric<=0 OR source_clock::numeric>extract(epoch FROM last_at)*1000 THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_future_or_invalid_source_clock';
              END IF;
            END IF;
          END LOOP;
        END LOOP;
        FOR source_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(payload->'data') LOOP
          FOREACH clock_name IN ARRAY CASE
            WHEN role_name IN ('order_before','order_after','positions') THEN ARRAY['cTime','uTime']
            WHEN role_name='balance' THEN ARRAY['uTime']
            WHEN role_name='account_risk' THEN ARRAY['ts'] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END LOOP
            source_clock := source_row->>clock_name;
            IF jsonb_typeof(source_row->clock_name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
               OR NOT coalesce(source_clock ~ '^[0-9]{1,16}$',false)
               OR source_clock::numeric<=0 OR source_clock::numeric>extract(epoch FROM last_at)*1000 THEN
              RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_required_source_clock';
            END IF;
          END LOOP;
          IF role_name IN ('order_before','order_after','positions')
             AND (source_row->>'cTime')::numeric>(source_row->>'uTime')::numeric THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_reversed_source_lifecycle';
          END IF;
          IF role_name='balance' THEN
            IF jsonb_typeof(source_row->'details') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
              RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_balance_details_required';
            END IF;
            FOR scalar IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_row->'details') LOOP
              source_clock := scalar->>'uTime';
              IF jsonb_typeof(scalar->'uTime') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
                 OR NOT coalesce(source_clock ~ '^[0-9]{1,16}$',false)
                 OR source_clock::numeric<=0 OR source_clock::numeric>extract(epoch FROM last_at)*1000 THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_balance_detail_source_clock';
              END IF;
            END LOOP;
          END IF;
        END LOOP;
        eof_milliseconds := eof_milliseconds || jsonb_build_object(role_name,extract(epoch FROM last_at)*1000);
        IF split_part(meta->>'request_url','?',1) IS DISTINCT FROM (witness->>'original_origin')||(meta->>'path')
           OR meta->>'tls_hostname' IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(witness->>'original_origin','/',3)
           OR NOT coalesce((meta->>'certificate_sha256') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$',false)
           OR NOT coalesce((meta->>'request_signature_sha256') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$',false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_actual_read_route_required';
        END IF;
        SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(value->>0,value->>1),'{}'::jsonb) INTO query
          FROM jsonb_array_elements(meta->'parameters');
        IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(query))<>jsonb_array_length(meta->'parameters') THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_query_identity_required';
        END IF;
        -- The SDK signs the original query order. Metadata stores an ordered
        -- canonical tuple; compare exact name/value members without inventing
        -- a sorted outgoing URL. All fixed-purpose values here are URL-safe.
        IF query='{}'::jsonb THEN
          IF meta->>'request_url' IS DISTINCT FROM (witness->>'original_origin')||(meta->>'path') THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_empty_query_required';
          END IF;
        ELSE
          IF cardinality(string_to_array(meta->>'request_url','?')) IS DISTINCT FROM 2
             OR cardinality(string_to_array(split_part(meta->>'request_url','?',2),'&'))
                  IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(meta->'parameters')
             OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(split_part(meta->>'request_url','?',2),'&')) v
                       WHERE cardinality(string_to_array(v,'='))<>2)
             OR (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(split_part(v,'=',1),split_part(v,'=',2))
                 FROM unnest(string_to_array(split_part(meta->>'request_url','?',2),'&')) v) IS DISTINCT FROM query THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_outgoing_query_required';
          END IF;
        END IF;
        documents := documents || jsonb_build_object(role_name,payload->'data');
        queries := queries || jsonb_build_object(role_name,query);
        IF role_name IN ('config_before','config_after','balance','positions','account_risk') THEN
          IF query<>'{}'::jsonb OR meta->>'path' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE role_name
             WHEN 'config_before' THEN '/api/v5/account/config' WHEN 'config_after' THEN '/api/v5/account/config'
             WHEN 'balance' THEN '/api/v5/account/balance' WHEN 'positions' THEN '/api/v5/account/positions'
             ELSE '/api/v5/account/account-position-risk' END) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_whole_account_query_required';
          END IF;
        ELSIF role_name IN ('order_before','order_after') THEN
          IF query IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('instId',expected->>'instId','clOrdId',expected->>'clOrdId')
             OR meta->>'path' IS DISTINCT FROM '/api/v5/trade/order' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_order_query_required';
          END IF;
        ELSIF role_name IN ('fills_recent','fills_history') THEN
          IF query IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('instType','SWAP','instId',expected->>'instId',
             'ordId',documents->'order_before'->0->>'ordId','limit','100')
             OR meta->>'path' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE role_name WHEN 'fills_recent'
             THEN '/api/v5/trade/fills' ELSE '/api/v5/trade/fills-history' END)
             OR payload->'data'<>'[]'::jsonb THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_zero_fills_required';
          END IF;
        ELSIF role_name='pending_orders' THEN
          IF query<>'{"limit":"100"}'::jsonb OR payload->'data'<>'[]'::jsonb
             OR meta->>'path' IS DISTINCT FROM '/api/v5/trade/orders-pending' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_pending_orders_required';
          END IF;
        ELSIF role_name LIKE 'algo_%' THEN
          IF query IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('ordType',substr(role_name,6),'limit','100')
             OR payload->'data'<>'[]'::jsonb OR meta->>'path' IS DISTINCT FROM '/api/v5/trade/orders-algo-pending' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_all_algo_types_required';
          END IF;
        ELSIF role_name='leverage' THEN
          IF query IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('instId',expected->>'instId','mgnMode','isolated')
             OR meta->>'path' IS DISTINCT FROM '/api/v5/account/leverage-info' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_actual_leverage_required';
          END IF;
        ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_unknown_role'; END IF;
      END LOOP;
      IF page_no<>19 OR NEW.updated_at-first_at>interval '60 seconds'
         OR documents->'config_before' IS DISTINCT FROM documents->'config_after'
         OR jsonb_array_length(documents->'config_before')<>1
         OR documents->'config_before'->0->>'uid' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
         OR documents->'config_before'->0->>'mainUid' IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'original_main_uid'
         OR documents->'config_before'->0->>'acctLv' IS DISTINCT FROM '2'
         OR documents->'config_before'->0->>'posMode' IS DISTINCT FROM inner_intent->'execution_binding'->>'position_mode'
         OR jsonb_array_length(documents->'order_before')<>1 OR jsonb_array_length(documents->'order_after')<>1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_actual_identity_and_terminal_order_required';
      END IF;
      FOR role_name IN SELECT unnest(ARRAY['order_before','order_after']) LOOP
        page := documents->role_name->0;
        FOREACH numeric_field IN ARRAY ARRAY['sz','px','accFillSz','avgPx'] LOOP
          IF numeric_field='avgPx' AND page->numeric_field='""'::jsonb THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
          IF jsonb_typeof(page->numeric_field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
             OR NOT coalesce((page->>numeric_field) ~ finite_decimal,false) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_finite_order_decimal_required';
          END IF;
        END LOOP;
        IF NOT COALESCE((page->>'instId'=expected->>'instId' AND page->>'instType'='SWAP'
           AND page->>'tdMode'='isolated' AND page->>'side'=expected->>'side'
           AND page->>'posSide'=expected->>'posSide' AND page->>'clOrdId'=expected->>'clOrdId'
           AND page->>'ordType'='fok' AND page->>'state'='canceled' AND page->>'reduceOnly'='false'
           AND (page->>'sz')::numeric>0 AND (page->>'px')::numeric>0
           AND (page->>'sz')::numeric=(expected->>'sz')::numeric
           AND (page->>'px')::numeric=(expected->>'px')::numeric
           AND (page->>'accFillSz')::numeric=0
           AND CASE WHEN page->>'avgPx'='' THEN true ELSE (page->>'avgPx')::numeric=0 END
           AND (page->>'ordId') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,39}$'),false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_terminal_zero_order_required';
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
      IF documents->'order_before'->0->>'ordId' IS DISTINCT FROM documents->'order_after'->0->>'ordId'
         OR jsonb_array_length(documents->'balance')<>1 OR jsonb_array_length(documents->'account_risk')<>1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_order_and_full_account_required';
      END IF;
      page := documents->'balance'->0;
      FOREACH numeric_field IN ARRAY ARRAY['eq','availEq','liab','borrowFroz'] LOOP
        IF jsonb_typeof(page->'details'->0->numeric_field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
           OR NOT coalesce((page->'details'->0->>numeric_field) ~ finite_decimal,false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_finite_balance_decimal_required';
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
      IF jsonb_typeof(page->'details') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(page->'details')<>1
         OR page->'details'->0->>'ccy' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency
         OR NOT COALESCE(((page->'details'->0->>'eq')::numeric>0
             AND (page->'details'->0->>'availEq')::numeric>=0
             AND (page->'details'->0->>'availEq')::numeric<=(page->'details'->0->>'eq')::numeric
             AND (page->'details'->0->>'liab')::numeric=0
             AND (page->'details'->0->>'borrowFroz')::numeric=0),false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_settlement_liability_scope_required';
      END IF;
      page := documents->'account_risk'->0;
      IF jsonb_typeof(page->'balData'->0->'eq') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
         OR NOT coalesce((page->'balData'->0->>'eq') ~ finite_decimal,false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_finite_risk_decimal_required';
      END IF;
      FOR scalar IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(page->'posData')
          UNION ALL SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents->'positions') LOOP
        IF jsonb_typeof(scalar->'pos') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
           OR NOT coalesce((scalar->>'pos') ~ finite_decimal,false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_finite_position_decimal_required';
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
      IF (documents->'balance'->0->>'uTime')::numeric>(page->>'ts')::numeric
         OR (documents->'balance'->0->'details'->0->>'uTime')::numeric>(page->>'ts')::numeric
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents->'positions') x
                   WHERE (x->>'uTime')::numeric>(page->>'ts')::numeric) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_account_snapshot_cutoff_required';
      END IF;
      IF jsonb_typeof(page->'balData') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(page->'balData')<>1
         OR page->'balData'->0->>'ccy' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency
         OR NOT COALESCE((page->'balData'->0->>'eq')::numeric>0,false)
         OR jsonb_typeof(page->'posData') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(page->'posData') x
                   WHERE NOT COALESCE((x->>'pos')::numeric=0,false))
         OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents->'positions') x
                   WHERE NOT COALESCE((x->>'pos')::numeric=0,false)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_fresh_flat_inventory_required';
      END IF;
      FOR scalar IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents->'leverage') LOOP
        IF jsonb_typeof(scalar->'lever') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
           OR NOT coalesce((scalar->>'lever') ~ finite_decimal,false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_finite_leverage_decimal_required';
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
      IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(documents->'leverage') x
          WHERE x->>'instId'=expected->>'instId' AND x->>'mgnMode'='isolated'
            AND x->>'posSide'=expected->>'posSide'
            AND (x->>'lever')::numeric=(request->'risk_inputs'->>'requested_leverage')::numeric)<>1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_actual_isolated_leverage_required';
      END IF;
      native_ok := true;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      native_ok := false;
    END;
  END IF;
  IF NOT native_ok AND OLD.state='uncertain' AND NEW.state='reconciled_flat'
     AND OLD.state_revision=3 AND NEW.state_revision=4 AND OLD.environment='demo'
     AND OLD.request_json::jsonb->>'contract_version'='ctcc-reservation-request-native-v4' THEN
    native_ok := public.qualification_native_filled_flat_data_v55(OLD.reservation_id,NEW.updated_at);
  END IF;
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY['state','state_revision','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY['state','state_revision','updated_at'])
     OR NEW.state_revision <> OLD.state_revision + 1
     OR NEW.updated_at < OLD.updated_at
     OR NOT ((OLD.state = 'reserved' AND NEW.state IN ('consumed','uncertain','reconciled_flat'))
             OR (OLD.state = 'consumed' AND NEW.state = 'uncertain') OR native_ok) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'qualification_reservation_update_denied';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END; $function$
functions.name: qualification_reservation_update
functions.source:
DECLARE
  native_ok boolean := false;
  s record; c record; o record; prior record; t record; b record; m record; p record; q record; issued record;
  lineage record; capture_row record;
  witness jsonb; manifest jsonb; assessment jsonb; request jsonb; inner_intent jsonb; expected jsonb;
  page jsonb; meta jsonb; part jsonb; payload jsonb; query jsonb;
  issued_snapshot jsonb; source_reference jsonb; event_document jsonb; original_plan jsonb;
  issued_snapshot_json text;
  scalar jsonb; source_row jsonb; source_clock text; clock_name text; numeric_field text;
  documents jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; queries jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  eof_milliseconds jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  role_name text; part_id text; body bytea; old_head text := NULL;
  sequence_no bigint := 0; offset_no bigint; page_no integer := 0;
  outcome_revision bigint := 0; previous_recorded_at timestamptz;
  first_at timestamptz; last_at timestamptz; previous_eof timestamptz;
  first_mono numeric; previous_mono numeric; read_session text; credential_session text;
  lock_hex text; names text[] := ARRAY[
    'config_before','order_before','fills_recent','fills_history','balance','positions','account_risk',
    'pending_orders','algo_conditional','algo_oco','algo_chase','algo_trigger','algo_move_order_stop',
    'algo_iceberg','algo_twap','algo_smart_iceberg','leverage','order_after','config_after'];
  finite_decimal text := '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,23})(\.[0-9]{1,24})?$';
  capture_sequence bigint := 0; capture_bytes bigint := 0; capture_head text := NULL;
  packet_count integer := 0; packet_sha256 text;
BEGIN
  -- This branch computes a DATA predicate from retained rows/raw documents.
  -- The application additionally requires its genuine new read-source owner,
  -- immutable target and independent committed full readback. No JSON flag is
  -- an owner, order permit, renewed Arm or source-authentication assertion.
  IF OLD.state='uncertain' AND NEW.state='reconciled_flat'
     AND OLD.state_revision=3 AND NEW.state_revision=4
     AND OLD.environment='demo'
     AND OLD.request_json::jsonb->>'contract_version'='ctcc-reservation-request-native-v4' THEN
    BEGIN
      request := OLD.request_json::jsonb;
      lock_hex := encode(sha256(convert_to('ctcc-qualification-account-v1','UTF8') || decode('00','hex') ||
        convert_to(OLD.environment,'UTF8') || decode('00','hex') || convert_to(OLD.account_id,'UTF8')),'hex');
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks l WHERE l.locktype='advisory'
        AND l.pid=pg_backend_pid() AND l.granted AND l.mode='ExclusiveLock' AND l.objsubid=1
        AND l.database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
        AND l.classid::bigint=(('x'||substr(lock_hex,1,8))::bit(32)::bigint)
        AND l.objid::bigint=(('x'||substr(lock_hex,9,8))::bit(32)::bigint)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_actual_uid_lock_required';
      END IF;
      -- Reconciliation never renews Arm/lease. It nevertheless serializes the
      -- actual current Control before scope, including expired/stopped states.
      SELECT * INTO c FROM public.demo_account_controls
        WHERE environment=OLD.environment AND account_id=OLD.account_id FOR UPDATE;
      IF c.account_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_control_required'; END IF;
      SELECT * INTO s FROM public.qualification_account_scopes
        WHERE environment=OLD.environment AND account_id=OLD.account_id
          AND settlement_currency=OLD.settlement_currency FOR UPDATE;
      SELECT * INTO b FROM public.qualification_reservation_transitions
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id AND state_revision=1;
      SELECT * INTO t FROM public.qualification_reservation_transitions
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id AND state_revision=2;
      SELECT * INTO prior FROM public.qualification_reservation_transitions
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id AND state_revision=3;
      SELECT * INTO o FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
      IF s.account_id IS NULL OR t.id IS NULL OR b.id IS NULL OR prior.id IS NULL OR o.outcome_id IS NULL
         OR s.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.updated_at OR o.recorded_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.updated_at
         OR s.ledger_revision IS DISTINCT FROM o.ledger_revision
         OR prior.from_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'consumed' OR prior.to_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'uncertain'
         OR prior.reason_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'post_submit_native_uncertain_v1'
         OR prior.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.updated_at
         OR b.from_state IS NOT NULL OR b.to_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'reserved'
         OR b.reason_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'risk_reserved_control_bound_v1'
         OR t.from_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'reserved' OR t.to_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'consumed'
         OR t.reason_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'consumed_with_control_bound_intent_v1'
         OR t.evidence_json::jsonb->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc-control-bound-submit-intent-v1'
         OR t.evidence_json::jsonb->>'reservation_binding_json' IS DISTINCT FROM b.evidence_json
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(t.evidence_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM o.intent_sha256
         OR o.intent_transition_id IS DISTINCT FROM t.id OR o.observation_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'reconciliation'
         OR o.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'rejected' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_lineage_required';
      END IF;
      inner_intent := (t.evidence_json::jsonb->>'intent_json')::jsonb;
      expected := inner_intent->'exact_order';
      witness := o.capture_json::jsonb;
      IF inner_intent->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc-demo-submit-intent-native-v2'
         OR inner_intent->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_sha256
         OR witness->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_zero_fok_flat_closure.v1'
         OR witness->>'reservation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_id
         OR witness->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_sha256
         OR witness->>'intent_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM o.intent_sha256
         OR witness->>'original_credential_session_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
         OR witness->>'issued_row_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'issued_row_sha256'
         OR (witness->>'exact_order_json')::jsonb IS DISTINCT FROM expected
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(witness->>'exact_order_json','UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM o.exchange_request_sha256
         OR witness->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR witness->'order_retry_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR expected->>'ordType' IS DISTINCT FROM 'fok' OR expected->>'tdMode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'isolated'
         OR expected->'reduceOnly' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR NOT COALESCE(expected->>'side' IN ('buy','sell'),false)
         OR expected->>'posSide' IS DISTINCT FROM inner_intent->'execution_binding'->>'position_side'
         OR expected->>'clOrdId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc'||left(OLD.reservation_id,28)
         OR inner_intent->>'protection_client_order_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CTA'||left(OLD.reservation_id,29) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_native_witness_required';
      END IF;
      SELECT * INTO issued FROM public.demo_collector_issued_account_revisions
        WHERE issuer_sha256=request->>'issuer_sha256';
      -- Recompute the existing canonical flat20 snapshot from the ACTUAL row.
      -- JSON-valued claims/proof remain original canonical ASCII strings,
      -- never decoded and reserialized. All actual source-supported scalar
      -- strings must be printable ASCII: canonical ensure_ascii=True already
      -- escapes Unicode/control members INSIDE the retained claims/proof.
      -- This avoids pretending generic Unicode jsonb::text equals that codec.
      -- Timestamp strings match the issuer's UTC isoformat
      -- (six microsecond digits when nonzero, no fractional suffix when zero).
      issued_snapshot := to_jsonb(issued) || jsonb_build_object(
        'original_expires_at',to_char(issued.original_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')||
          CASE WHEN extract(microseconds FROM issued.original_expires_at)::bigint % 1000000=0 THEN ''
          ELSE '.'||to_char(issued.original_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','US') END||'+00:00',
        'db_recorded_at',to_char(issued.db_recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')||
          CASE WHEN extract(microseconds FROM issued.db_recorded_at)::bigint % 1000000=0 THEN ''
          ELSE '.'||to_char(issued.db_recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','US') END||'+00:00');
      FOR scalar IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_each(issued_snapshot) LOOP
        IF jsonb_typeof(scalar)='string' AND NOT coalesce((scalar#>>'{}') COLLATE "C" ~ '^[ -~]*$',false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_issued_canonical_ascii_required';
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
      SELECT '{'||string_agg(to_jsonb(key)::text||':'||value::text,',' ORDER BY key COLLATE "C")||'}'
        INTO issued_snapshot_json FROM jsonb_each(issued_snapshot);
      IF issued.issuer_sha256 IS NULL OR issued.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment
         OR issued.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
         OR issued.settlement_currency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency
         OR issued.account_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (request->>'expected_account_revision')::bigint
         OR issued.ledger_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (request->>'expected_ledger_revision')::bigint
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(issued.proof_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM issued.issuer_sha256
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(issued.claims_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM issued.claims_sha256
         OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(issued_snapshot))<>20
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(issued_snapshot_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'issued_row_sha256' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_issued_row_required';
      END IF;
      SELECT * INTO lineage FROM public.demo_collector_current_revision_lineages
        WHERE lineage_sha256=issued.source_lineage_sha256;
      IF lineage.lineage_sha256 IS NULL
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(lineage.lineage_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM lineage.lineage_sha256
         OR lineage.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment OR lineage.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
         OR lineage.settlement_currency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_lineage_required';
      END IF;
      source_reference := lineage.lineage_json::jsonb->'source_reference';
      -- Replay the entire ORIGINAL immutable B1 chain under this same writer
      -- transaction, rather than accepting a fresh config's self-asserted UID.
      FOR capture_row IN SELECT * FROM public.demo_account_capture_events
        WHERE capture_id=lineage.current_capture_id ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 8193 LOOP
        capture_sequence := capture_sequence+1;
        capture_bytes := capture_bytes+octet_length(capture_row.event_json)
          +coalesce(octet_length(capture_row.raw_body),0)+coalesce(octet_length(capture_row.packet_payload),0);
        event_document := capture_row.event_json::jsonb;
        IF capture_sequence>8192 OR capture_bytes>67108864 OR capture_row.sequence<>capture_sequence
           OR capture_row.chain_bytes<>capture_bytes OR capture_row.previous_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM capture_head
           OR capture_row.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment OR capture_row.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
           OR capture_row.settlement_currency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency
           OR encode(sha256(convert_to(capture_row.event_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM capture_row.event_sha256
           OR event_document->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.demo_account_ingestion_event.v1'
           OR event_document->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM capture_row.capture_id
           OR (event_document->>'sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM capture_sequence
           OR event_document->>'previous_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM capture_head
           OR event_document->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
           OR event_document->'account_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
           OR event_document->>'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DENY'
           OR event_document->>'raw_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN capture_row.raw_body IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE encode(sha256(capture_row.raw_body),'hex') END)
           OR event_document->>'packet_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN capture_row.packet_payload IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE encode(sha256(capture_row.packet_payload),'hex') END) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_capture_chain_required';
        END IF;
        IF capture_sequence=1 THEN
          original_plan := event_document->'data'->'plan';
          IF event_document->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'capture_start'
             OR event_document->'data'->>'plan_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM source_reference->>'plan_sha256'
             OR event_document->'data'->>'session_binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
             OR encode(sha256(convert_to(original_plan->>'session_binding_id','UTF8')),'hex')
                  IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
             OR original_plan->>'expected_uid' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id
             OR original_plan->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment
             OR original_plan->>'settlement_currency' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_currency
             OR original_plan->>'expected_main_uid' IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'original_main_uid'
             OR NOT coalesce((original_plan->>'expected_main_uid') ~ '^[0-9]{1,32}$',false)
             OR original_plan->>'origin' IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'original_origin'
             OR original_plan->>'origin' IS NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_account_identity_required';
          END IF;
        END IF;
        IF capture_row.packet_payload IS NOT NULL THEN
          packet_count := packet_count+1;
          packet_sha256 := encode(sha256(capture_row.packet_payload),'hex');
        END IF;
        capture_head := capture_row.event_sha256;
      END LOOP;
      IF capture_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM lineage.current_terminal_sequence OR capture_sequence<2
         OR capture_head IS DISTINCT FROM lineage.current_head_sha256 OR packet_count<>1
         OR source_reference->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM lineage.current_capture_id
         OR source_reference->>'head_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM capture_head
         OR source_reference->>'packet_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM packet_sha256
         OR source_reference->>'session_binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
         OR event_document->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal'
         OR event_document->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete_recorded' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_original_complete_capture_required';
      END IF;
      -- All retained outcomes remain an immutable exact chain; a late witness
      -- cannot discard an earlier ACK/unknown, part or conflicting observation.
      FOR q IN SELECT * FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
        WHERE reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 4097 LOOP
        sequence_no := sequence_no+1;
        IF sequence_no>4096 OR q.sequence<>sequence_no OR q.previous_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM old_head
           OR q.intent_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM o.intent_sha256 OR q.intent_transition_id IS DISTINCT FROM t.id
           OR q.exchange_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM o.exchange_request_sha256
           OR encode(sha256(convert_to(q.capture_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM q.capture_sha256
           OR encode(sha256(convert_to(q.outcome_json,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM q.outcome_id
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_submission_outcome.v1'
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'capture_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM q.capture_sha256
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'reservation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_id
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'sequence')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM q.sequence
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'previous_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM q.previous_sha256
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'intent_transition_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM t.id
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'intent_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM q.intent_sha256
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'exchange_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM q.exchange_request_sha256
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_sha256
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM q.status
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'observation_kind' IS DISTINCT FROM q.observation_kind
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'ledger_revision')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM q.ledger_revision
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM q.recorded_at
           OR (q.outcome_json::jsonb->>'observed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM q.observed_at
           OR q.ledger_revision<=outcome_revision OR q.observed_at>q.recorded_at
           OR (previous_recorded_at IS NOT NULL AND q.recorded_at<previous_recorded_at)
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
           OR q.outcome_json::jsonb->'order_retry_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
           OR (sequence_no=1 AND (q.observation_kind<>'initial' OR q.status<>'uncertain')) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_outcome_chain_required';
        END IF;
        old_head := q.outcome_id;
        outcome_revision := q.ledger_revision;
        previous_recorded_at := q.recorded_at;
      END LOOP;
      IF sequence_no<3 OR old_head IS DISTINCT FROM o.outcome_id THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_outcome_chain_required';
      END IF;
      SELECT * INTO m FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
        WHERE outcome_id=witness->>'manifest_outcome_id' AND reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id;
      manifest := m.capture_json::jsonb;
      assessment := (witness->>'assessment_json')::jsonb;
      IF m.outcome_id IS NULL OR m.sequence>=o.sequence OR m.observation_kind<>'reconciliation'
         OR m.status<>'uncertain' OR manifest->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_read_manifest.v1'
         OR manifest->>'computation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'
         OR manifest->>'reservation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_id
         OR manifest->>'assessment_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'assessment_sha256'
         OR encode(sha256(convert_to(witness->>'assessment_json','UTF8')),'hex')
              IS DISTINCT FROM witness->>'assessment_sha256'
         OR assessment->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_postsubmit_reconciliation_computation.v1'
         OR assessment->>'reservation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reservation_id
         OR assessment->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_sha256
         OR assessment->>'intent_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM o.intent_sha256
         OR assessment->'execution_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR assessment->'order_retry_authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
         OR assessment->>'classification' IS DISTINCT FROM 'terminal_zero_fill_flat'
         OR jsonb_typeof(manifest->'pages') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
         OR jsonb_array_length(manifest->'pages')<>19 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_manifest_required';
      END IF;
      FOR page IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'pages') LOOP
        page_no := page_no+1;
        role_name := page->>'role';
        IF role_name IS DISTINCT FROM names[page_no] OR page_no>19 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_required_chronology_missing';
        END IF;
        SELECT * INTO p FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
          WHERE outcome_id=page->>'metadata' AND reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id;
        meta := p.capture_json::jsonb;
        IF p.outcome_id IS NULL OR p.sequence>=m.sequence OR p.observation_kind<>'reconciliation' OR p.status<>'uncertain'
           OR meta->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_read_page_metadata.v1'
           OR meta->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->>'capture_id'
           OR (meta->>'page_index')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM page_no-1 OR meta->>'role' IS DISTINCT FROM role_name
           OR (meta->>'status')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM 200 OR jsonb_typeof(page->'parts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
           OR NOT jsonb_array_length(page->'parts') BETWEEN 1 AND 8 THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_page_metadata_required';
        END IF;
        IF page_no=1 THEN
          first_at := (meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz;
          first_mono := (meta->>'started_monotonic_ns')::numeric;
          read_session := meta->>'read_session_id';
          credential_session := meta->>'credential_session_sha256';
        END IF;
        last_at := (meta->>'eof_at')::timestamptz;
        IF NOT COALESCE((read_session ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND credential_session ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
           AND credential_session IS DISTINCT FROM request->>'credential_session_sha256'
           AND meta->>'read_session_id'=read_session AND meta->>'credential_session_sha256'=credential_session
           AND meta->>'original_credential_session_sha256'=request->>'credential_session_sha256'
           AND first_at<=(meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz
           AND (meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz<=(meta->>'headers_at')::timestamptz
           AND (meta->>'headers_at')::timestamptz<=last_at AND last_at<=NEW.updated_at
           AND (meta->>'started_monotonic_ns')::numeric<=(meta->>'headers_monotonic_ns')::numeric
           AND (meta->>'headers_monotonic_ns')::numeric<=(meta->>'eof_monotonic_ns')::numeric
           AND (previous_eof IS NULL OR previous_eof<(meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz)
           AND (previous_mono IS NULL OR previous_mono<(meta->>'started_monotonic_ns')::numeric)
           AND (meta->>'eof_monotonic_ns')::numeric-first_mono<=60000000000),false) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_new_read_session_or_chronology_required';
        END IF;
        previous_eof := last_at;
        previous_mono := (meta->>'eof_monotonic_ns')::numeric;
        body := ''::bytea; offset_no := 0;
        FOR part_id IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(page->'parts') LOOP
          SELECT * INTO q FROM public.qualification_submission_outcomes
            WHERE outcome_id=part_id AND reservation_id=OLD.reservation_id;
          part := q.capture_json::jsonb;
          IF q.outcome_id IS NULL OR q.sequence<=p.sequence OR q.sequence>=m.sequence
             OR q.observation_kind<>'reconciliation' OR q.status<>'uncertain'
             OR part->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ctcc.native_read_raw_part.v1'
             OR part->>'capture_id' IS DISTINCT FROM manifest->>'capture_id'
             OR (part->>'page_index')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM page_no-1
             OR part->>'metadata_outcome_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p.outcome_id
             OR (part->>'offset')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM offset_no
             OR NOT COALESCE((octet_length(part->>'raw_hex') BETWEEN 2 AND 131072
                 AND octet_length(part->>'raw_hex') % 2=0
                 AND (part->>'raw_hex') ~ '^[a-f0-9]+$'),false)
             OR encode(sha256(decode(part->>'raw_hex','hex')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM part->>'raw_sha256' THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_exact_raw_parts_required';
          END IF;
          body := body || decode(part->>'raw_hex','hex');
          offset_no := octet_length(body);
          IF offset_no>524288 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_raw_page_bound'; END IF;
        END LOOP;
        IF offset_no IS DISTINCT FROM (meta->>'body_bytes')::bigint
           OR encode(sha256(body),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM meta->>'body_sha256'
           OR meta->>'body_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM page->>'body_sha256' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_raw_page_digest_required';
        END IF;
        payload := convert_from(body,'UTF8')::jsonb;
        IF payload->>'code' IS DISTINCT FROM '0' OR jsonb_typeof(payload->'data') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
           OR jsonb_typeof(meta->'parameters') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'native_zero_fok_complete_raw_document_required';
        END IF;
        -- Every present source clock is checked against THIS page's actual
        -- EOF. Update times may remain old; they are never restamped or forced
        -- to follow dispatch. Nested risk members have no invented clock.
        FOR q IN
          WITH RECURSIVE nodes(value,depth) AS (
            SELECT convert_from(body,'UTF8')::json,0
            UNION ALL
            SELECT child.value,n.depth+1 FROM nodes n CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
              SELECT value FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_typeof(n.value)='object' THEN n.value ELSE '{}'::json END)
              UNION ALL
              SELECT value FROM json_array_elements(CASE WHEN json_typeof(n.value)='array' THEN n.value ELSE '[]'::json END)
            ) child
          ) SELECT value,depth,json_typeof(value) AS kind FROM nodes
        LOOP

          -- to jsonb would discard an earlier conflicting member. Match the
          -- existing strict native decoder's plain DATA limits as well.
